Supports receiving workflows, vendor compliance chargebacks, and inventory accuracy at point of induction.

attributes.name: receiving_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location type where goods were received. 'dc' = Distribution Center; 'store' = retail store; 'mfc' = Micro-Fulfillment Center; 'dark_store' = fulfillment-only location. Determines applicable receiving workflows and inventory induction rules.

attributes.name: reservation_status

products.name: node_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the assortment planning decision between inventory_node and item_hierarchy. It captures the strategic and operational decisions about which merchandise categories are carried at which locations, including space allocation, planogram assignments, and replenishment rules. Each record links one inventory_node to one item_hierarchy node with attributes that govern how that category is merchandised at that specific location.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, assortment planning is a core business process where each inventory node (store, DC, MFC) carries multiple merchandise categories, and each category is carried across multiple locations with location-specific merchandising rules. Store planners and category managers actively manage these node-category assortment decisions, allocating shelf space, assigning planograms, setting presentation quantities, and defining replenishment priorities that vary by location format, customer demographics, and regional preferences. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational planning entity that humans create, update, and monitor.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: In B2B retail scenarios, contact persons (buyers, procurement managers, store managers) are associated with corporate accounts. A contact belongs to one account while an account can have many contacts

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile or corporate account that owns this contact method. Links to the customer master record in the customer master data system.

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times communication attempts via this contact method have bounced or failed. Used to trigger contact validation workflows and suppress invalid addresses.

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint where the customer provided consent for this contact method (e.g., web registration, mobile app, POS, call center, in-store signup). Supports consent audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|pos|call_center|email|in_store|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact method. Active indicates usable for communication; bounced/invalid indicates delivery failure; suppressed indicates customer request or compliance block; pending_verification indicates awaiting confirmation.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: The type or category of contact method (e.g., primary email, mobile phone, work phone, WhatsApp, SMS, fax). Determines the channel and priority for omnichannel outreach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_email|secondary_email|mobile|home_phone|work_phone|whatsapp|sms|fax — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country associated with this contact method (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Used for regional compliance and localization of communications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact method record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact method ceased to be active or valid. Nullable for currently active contact methods. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this contact method became active and valid for customer communication. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary contact method for the customer. Used to prioritize communication channels in omnichannel campaigns and clienteling.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact method has been verified (e.g., email verification link clicked, phone number confirmed via OTP). Ensures data quality for marketing and transactional communications.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the customers preferred language for communications via this contact method (e.g., en, es, fr). Supports personalized omnichannel outreach.

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent bounce or delivery failure for this contact method. Nullable if no bounces have occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact method record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact method was last successfully used for customer communication (email sent, SMS delivered, call completed). Helps identify stale or inactive contact points.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority order of this contact method relative to other contact methods for the same customer. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for fallback logic in omnichannel campaigns.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this contact method in the source system. Enables traceability and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual contact point value: email address, phone number, or social media handle. This is the primary data element used for customer communication and CRM campaigns via the case management system. Classified as restricted PII as it may contain email, phone, or other personal identifiers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact method was last verified by the customer. Used to track data freshness and trigger re-verification workflows.

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with a customer profile or corporate account. Stores address type (billing, shipping, store pickup, home, work), full address lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, geocoordinates (lat/lng), address validation status, USPS/postal standardization flag, and default shipping flag. Critical for last-mile delivery, BOPIS/ROPIS fulfillment, and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or corporate account associated with this address.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are available for use in orders and shipments.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: billing, shipping, store pickup (BOPIS/ROPIS), home, work, or mailing.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR) identifying the country of the address.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special delivery instructions provided by the customer (e.g., gate code, leave at door, ring bell).

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Barcode (DPBC) or equivalent postal barcode for automated mail sorting and delivery.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address becomes active and valid for use in transactions.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this address remains active. Null indicates the address is currently active with no end date.

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is the default billing address for the customer.

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is the default shipping destination for the customer.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this address was last used in a transaction (order, shipment, or billing event).

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geolocation and last-mile delivery optimization.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and unit/apartment number.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building name, floor, suite, or department.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geolocation and last-mile delivery optimization.

attributes.name: military_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a military address (APO/FPO/DPO). Requires special handling for international military mail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.description: Customer-provided friendly name for the address (e.g., Home, Office, Mom's House) for easy identification.

attributes.name: po_box_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a PO Box. Some carriers and products cannot deliver to PO Boxes.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode for the address. Used for delivery routing and tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: residential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is a residential location (true) or commercial/business location (false). Impacts shipping rates and delivery windows.

attributes.name: standardization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized to postal service formatting rules (USPS Publication 28, etc.).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code or name. For US addresses, use two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier derived from the address, used to determine applicable sales tax rates and rules.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of address validation against postal service standards (USPS, Canada Post, etc.). Validated addresses reduce delivery failures.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Informatica Address Verification

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the address was last verified against postal service databases or address validation services.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of all merchandise including SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, EANs, product hierarchies (department, category, subcategory), attributes, descriptions, images, private label vs. national brands, and assortment depth and breadth classifications. Managed via PIM (Product Information Management) and MDM systems. Supports category management, new item setup, and product lifecycle from introduction to discontinuation.

products.name: sku
products.description: Authoritative master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the retail assortment. This is the SSOT for all SKU-level product identity and physical characteristics across the enterprise. Captures the unique sellable unit identity including UPC, EAN, GTIN, internal item number, SKU description, brand reference, unit of measure, pack size, weight, dimensions (gross/net weight, length, width, height, volume, cube), ti-hi pallet configuration, temperature requirement, stackability, country of origin, hazmat flag, age-restriction flag, shelf life, product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal, clearance, pending setup), and creation/modification timestamps. Aligned with GS1 GDSN Trade Item standard. Sourced from the customer master data system and the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS). Central hub entity — all other product domain entities reference this record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: add column product_brand_id (BIGINT) with FK to product.product_brand.product_brand_id - SKUs belong to brands and this relationship is fundamental for brand-level reporting and assortment planning

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: sku has department_code, category_code, subcategory_code (all STRING) which should be normalized to a single FK to item_hierarchy. The hierarchy table is the authoritative source for merchandise taxon

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: sku.unit_of_measure (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK to uom reference table. UOM is the authoritative master for all units of measure with conversion factors and standards compliance (GS1

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary supplier or vendor who provides this SKU to the retailer. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, mature-rated products). True if age-restricted, False if not.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cube
attributes.description: Cubic volume of the SKU package calculated as length × width × height. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization. Measured in cubic feet or cubic meters.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SKU including key product attributes, features, and specifications. Used for product information management and customer-facing displays.

attributes.name: dimension_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height fields. IN (Inch), CM (Centimeter), FT (Foot), M (Meter).

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU will be or was discontinued and removed from the active assortment. Null if the SKU is not planned for discontinuation. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number used for product identification globally. International barcode standard.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU becomes active and available for sale. Used for new product launches and seasonal assortment planning. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the SKU including packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for shipping and logistics calculations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits. Umbrella term encompassing UPC, EAN, and other GS1 identifiers.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures. True if hazmat, False if not.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: Number of layers (tiers) that can be stacked on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the primary product image. Used for e-commerce, mobile apps, and digital signage.

attributes.name: internal_item_number
attributes.description: Retailer-specific internal product identifier used in legacy systems and internal operations. May differ from external GTIN/UPC.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the product assortment. ACTIVE (currently sold), DISCONTINUED (no longer ordered), SEASONAL (sold during specific periods), CLEARANCE (being phased out), PENDING_SETUP (not yet available for sale), INACTIVE (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this SKU. Null if no age restriction applies. Typically 18 or 21 for restricted products.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last modified in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product contents excluding packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for regulatory compliance and consumer information.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in a single sellable pack. For example, a 6-pack of soda has pack_size = 6.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product or a national brand. True for private label, False for national brand.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains sellable and safe for consumption from the date of manufacture or receipt. Critical for perishable goods and inventory rotation.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated product description for use in constrained display contexts such as receipts, labels, and mobile interfaces. Typically 40-60 characters.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU can be safely stacked during storage and transportation. True if stackable, False if not.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Storage and transportation temperature requirement for the SKU. AMBIENT (room temperature), REFRIGERATED (32-40°F), FROZEN (below 0°F), CONTROLLED (specific temperature range).

attributes.name: ti
attributes.description: Number of units per layer on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code used for point-of-sale scanning in North America. Standard barcode identifier for retail products.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The supplier's own product identifier for this SKU. Used for purchase orders and vendor communication.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volume or capacity of the product, measured in the unit specified by volume_unit_of_measure. Relevant for liquid and bulk products.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume field. GAL (Gallon), LTR (Liter), ML (Milliliter), OZ (Fluid Ounce), QT (Quart).

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross_weight and net_weight fields. LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), OZ (Ounce), G (Gram).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

products.name: item_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the full merchandise hierarchy and category taxonomy used to organize SKUs into departments, categories, subcategories, and segments for both operational and strategic purposes. This is the SSOT for all product classification and category management taxonomy. Captures hierarchy node identity, node code, node name, level (department, category, subcategory, segment), parent node reference (self-referencing for tree traversal), hierarchy path, hierarchy type (operational, strategic/category management), buyer assignment, planner assignment, strategic classification (destination, routine, convenience, seasonal), assortment breadth/depth targets, category manager, and effective dates. Supports category management, assortment planning, planogram design, financial reporting roll-ups, and NRF ARTS merchandise hierarchy alignment. Managed in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item hierarchy node. Primary key for the item hierarchy entity. This is the system-generated surrogate key for each node in the merchandise hierarchy tree.

attributes.name: parent_hierarchy_node_item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent node in the hierarchy tree. Self-referencing relationship enabling tree traversal and roll-up aggregations. Null for top-level division nodes.

attributes.name: allows_direct_sku_assignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allows Direct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Assignment Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether SKUs can be directly assigned to this hierarchy node. Typically True for leaf nodes (subcategory, segment, class) and False for parent nodes (division, department, category). Controls data quality and hierarchy integrity in PIM (Product Information Management) systems.

tag_set.value: Allows Direct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) Assignment Flag

attributes.name: assortment_breadth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct subcategories or product families within this category. Assortment breadth measures the range of categories offered. Used in category management and OTB (Open to Buy) planning.

attributes.name: assortment_depth_target
attributes.description: Target number of distinct SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) within a subcategory or product family. Assortment depth measures the variety within a category. Deeper assortments offer more choice but increase inventory complexity and carrying costs.

attributes.name: category_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the category manager responsible for strategic category management, assortment optimization, and category P&L performance. Category managers define assortment breadth and depth targets and drive GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and master data governance. Automatically populated by the customer master data system (Master Data Management) or source system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score (0-100) calculated by the customer master data system based on completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness rules. Scores below threshold trigger data stewardship workflows. Supports master data governance and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node is retired or deprecated. Null for currently active nodes. Supports historical reporting and category lifecycle management. Enables analysis of discontinued categories and assortment changes over time.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node becomes active and available for use in assortment planning, purchase orders, and reporting. Supports time-variant hierarchy structures and seasonal category introductions.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External identifier from source system or third-party data provider. Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration, and external reporting. Examples: GS1 category codes, NRF ARTS hierarchy IDs, supplier category codes.

attributes.name: hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node purpose, scope, and business rules. Includes category definition, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and merchandising guidelines. Used for training, onboarding, and cross-functional alignment.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this node within the merchandise hierarchy tree. Defines the depth and classification granularity. Division is the highest level, followed by department, category, subcategory, segment, and class as the most granular.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. This is the externally-known unique code used in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA MM module for category management and reporting. Examples: DEPT01, CAT-ELEC, SUBCAT-TV.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Examples: Electronics, Home Appliances, Televisions, 4K Smart TVs. Used in reporting, planograms, and category management dashboards.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to current node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DIVISION01/DEPT05/CAT-ELEC/SUBCAT-TV. Enables efficient hierarchy queries and reporting roll-ups without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy purpose. Operational hierarchies support daily store operations and planograms. Strategic hierarchies support category management and assortment planning. Financial hierarchies align with P&L reporting. Planning hierarchies support OTB (Open to Buy) and MRP (Material Requirements Planning).

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy tree. Leaf nodes are the most granular classification level and are directly associated with SKUs. True for leaf nodes, False for parent nodes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this hierarchy node record. Supports audit trail, accountability, and master data governance. Captured from the customer master data system workflow or source system authentication.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing. Updated automatically on every modification in the customer master data system or source system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average supplier delivery lead time in days for this category. Used in demand planning, safety stock calculations, and OTB (Open to Buy) planning. Managed in Blue Yonder Demand Planning and the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hierarchy node. Active nodes are in use for assortment planning and reporting. Inactive nodes are temporarily disabled. Pending nodes are awaiting approval. Deprecated nodes are being phased out. Archived nodes are retained for historical reporting only.

attributes.name: markdown_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency and timing of planned price markdowns for this category. Weekly and biweekly cadences support fast fashion and perishables. Monthly cadences support durable goods. Seasonal cadences align with end-of-season clearance. Event-driven markdowns respond to competitive pressure or excess inventory. Managed in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by suppliers for this category. Impacts purchase order planning, inventory carrying costs, and cash flow management. Negotiated by buyers and enforced in procurement systems.

attributes.name: omnichannel_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this category is available across all channels (stores, e-commerce, mobile app, BOPIS, ship-from-store). True for omnichannel categories, False for channel-specific categories. Supports unified commerce strategy and cross-channel inventory visibility.

attributes.name: planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandise planner responsible for demand forecasting, inventory planning, and replenishment for this category. Planners use Blue Yonder Demand Planning to optimize inventory levels and minimize stockouts and overstock.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing strategy classification for this category. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains consistent low prices. Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy) uses frequent promotions and markdowns. Premium targets higher-margin positioning. Competitive matches market pricing. Value emphasizes affordability. Managed in the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: private_label_penetration_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of category sales from private label (store brand) products. Private label products typically offer higher margins than national brands. Used in assortment planning and supplier negotiations to optimize category profitability.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Inventory replenishment method for this category. Auto uses system-driven replenishment based on demand forecasting. Manual requires planner intervention. Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates replenishment to suppliers. Cross-docking transfers inventory directly from receiving to shipping. Drop ship sends directly from vendor to customer.

attributes.name: safety_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target safety stock level expressed in weeks of supply (WOS). Buffer inventory to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Calculated based on service level targets and lead time variability in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_indicator
attributes.description: Seasonal demand pattern classification for this category. Non-seasonal categories have consistent year-round demand. Seasonal categories have predictable demand peaks tied to calendar periods. Used in demand forecasting, markdown planning, and inventory optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_seasonal|spring|summer|fall|winter|holiday|back_to_school — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering sibling nodes within the same parent. Used for consistent presentation in reports, planograms, and digital storefronts. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: strategic_classification
attributes.description: Strategic role of the category in the overall merchandising strategy. Destination categories drive store traffic and differentiation. Routine categories are frequently purchased staples. Convenience categories are impulse or fill-in purchases. Seasonal categories have time-bound demand. Private label vs. national brand classification supports margin optimization.

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this category, expressed as a percentage of net sales. Used in pricing strategy, markdown planning, and category performance evaluation. Supports GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) optimization.

products.name: attribute
products.description: Stores extended descriptive, technical, and measurement attributes for each SKU beyond core identity fields using a flexible entity-attribute-value (EAV) pattern. Captures attribute name, attribute value, attribute group (e.g., fabric, color, size, flavor, nutritional supplement, technical spec, UOM conversion, environmental certification, data quality score), data type, unit of measure, conversion factor, validation rule, source system, and locale/language for multilingual and multi-market support. Enables faceted search on e-commerce platforms, product comparison, PIM-driven enrichment, multi-UOM transaction support across procurement/inventory/POS, data completeness scoring for GS1 GDSN readiness, and regulatory attribute capture. Sourced from the customer master data system PIM module and the e-commerce platform product catalog. Aligned with GS1 GDSN attribute standards for trade item data synchronization.

attributes.name: attribute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product attribute record. Primary key for the product_attribute entity.

attributes.name: product_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent product (SKU) to which this attribute belongs. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: product_attribute.unit_of_measure is a STRING column storing a denormalized unit of measure reference. The uom table is the authoritative UOM master in this domain. Normalizing this to a FK attribute_

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the person who approved this product attribute value for publication. Supports accountability and audit trails in PIM workflows.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product attribute value was approved for publication or use in operational systems. Supports PIM workflow and governance processes.

attributes.name: attribute_group
attributes.description: Logical grouping or category of the attribute (e.g., 'physical', 'technical', 'descriptive', 'nutritional', 'environmental', 'regulatory', 'marketing', 'quality', 'packaging', 'pricing'). Enables faceted search and attribute organization in PIM systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical|technical|descriptive|nutritional|environmental|regulatory|marketing|quality|packaging|pricing — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attribute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this attribute record (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'pending_approval', 'deprecated', 'archived'). Supports attribute governance and PIM workflow management.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: The name of the organization or authority that certified this attribute value (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Energy Star', 'Fair Trade', 'UL Listed'). Applicable when is_certified is True.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this attribute value was certified. Applicable when is_certified is True. Supports audit trails and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric conversion factor to translate this attribute's unit of measure to a base or standard unit (e.g., 1 lb = 0.453592 kg). Enables cross-UOM calculations and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product attribute record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of this attribute value. Used for GS1 GDSN readiness assessment and PIM data quality dashboards.

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the attribute value (e.g., 'string', 'numeric', 'boolean', 'date', 'timestamp', 'decimal'). Used for validation and type-safe processing in downstream systems.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of attributes on product detail pages, labels, and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which this attribute value is effective. Null indicates the attribute is currently active. Supports historical attribute tracking and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this attribute value is effective and should be used in product displays, transactions, and reporting. Supports time-variant attribute management.

attributes.name: is_certified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this attribute value has been certified or verified by an authoritative source (e.g., environmental certification, organic certification, safety compliance). True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_comparable

products.name: item_variant

This is the SSOT for all inter-SKU relationships within the product domain. Stores source SKU reference, target SKU reference, relationship type (variant, substitution), dimension type (size, color, flavor, etc.), dimension value, substitution priority rank, channel applicability (in-store, online, BOPIS), customer consent required flag, variant-level UPC, and effective dates. attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Prop 65 chemicals present in the product that trigger warning requirements. Null if no Prop 65 warning required.
attributes.references: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act (Proposition 65)

attributes.name: prop_65_warning_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires a California Prop 65 warning label due to presence of chemicals known to cause cancer, birth defects, or reproductive harm.
attributes.references: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act (Proposition 65)

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date when the product recall was initiated. Null if no recall has been issued.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards

attributes.name: recall_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for the product recall (e.g., contamination, safety hazard, labeling error). Null if no recall.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards, FDA Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_severity_level
attributes.description: FDA classification of recall severity: Class 1 (serious health hazard or death), Class 2 (temporary health problem), Class 3 (unlikely to cause adverse health effects). Null if no recall.

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current recall status of the product indicating whether it is subject to a safety or quality recall.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards, FDA Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Sub-national region or state code where specific compliance requirements apply (e.g., CA for California Prop 65, NY for New York regulations).

attributes.name: responsible_party_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (phone or email) for the responsible party. Used for regulatory inquiries and recall coordination.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Responsible Party Requirements

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental certification (e.g., Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council, Forest Stewardship Council). Null if not certified.
attributes.references: Fair Trade International, Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council (MSC), Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)

attributes.name: tariff_classification_code
attributes.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) code used for customs classification and duty calculation for imported products.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, U.S. International Trade Commission (USITC)

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance test report issued by the testing laboratory. Null if no test report available.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party laboratory that conducted compliance testing (e.g., UL, Intertek, SGS, Bureau Veritas). Null if no third-party testing performed.

products.name: item_bundle
products.description: Defines product bundle and kit configurations where multiple component SKUs are sold together as a single sellable unit. Captures bundle SKU reference (the parent sellable unit), component SKU references, component quantity, component sequence, bundle type (fixed bundle, mix-and-match, gift set, kit, variety pack, multi-pack), pricing method (bundle price, component sum, discount percentage), component substitution allowed flag, and effective dates. Supports promotional bundling, gift set creation, variety packs, multi-pack configurations, and meal deal combos across all channels. Critical for POS scanning (bundle has its own GTIN), inventory component deduction, and promotional planning.

attributes.name: item_bundle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item bundle configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: bundle_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: item_bundle.bundle_sku (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK. The bundle itself is a SKU in the catalog. This links the bundle definition to its SKU master record. bundle_gtin can be retrieved

attributes.name: component_uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: item_bundle.component_quantity (DECIMAL) represents the quantity of a component SKU within a bundle, but without a unit of measure reference this quantity is ambiguous (is it 2 each? 2 kg? 2 liters?).

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Merchandising associates create promotional bundles and multi-packs. Tracking creator enables workflow management, approval routing, performance measurement, and audit trails for promotional planning

attributes.name: item_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Promotional bundles are often authorized only for specific stores or store clusters (e.g., seasonal bundles in tourist locations, regional promotions). Bundle authorization by store is required for pr

attributes.name: item_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor or supplier responsible for providing the bundle or its components. Used for vendor managed inventory and procurement.

attributes.name: assortment_category
attributes.description: The merchandising category or department this bundle belongs to for assortment planning and category management (e.g., Grocery, Apparel, Electronics).

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the bundle contents and value proposition for merchandising and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: The customer-facing name of the bundle (e.g., 'Summer BBQ Pack', 'Family Meal Deal', 'Holiday Gift Set').

attributes.name: bundle_price_amount
attributes.description: The selling price of the bundle when pricing_method is bundle_price. Represents the total customer-facing price.

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bundle: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), pending (awaiting approval), discontinued (permanently removed), seasonal (available during specific periods).

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle configuration: fixed_bundle (pre-defined components), mix_and_match (customer selects from options), gift_set (curated gift collection), kit (assembly required), variety_pack (multiple flavors/variants), multi_pack (quantity of same item).

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Defines which sales channels can sell this bundle: all_channels, store_only, online_only, bopis_eligible (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ship_from_store (fulfillment from store inventory).

attributes.name: component_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the component SKU included in one unit of the bundle. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based items.

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: The display order or assembly sequence of this component within the bundle. Used for kit assembly instructions and merchandising display.

attributes.name: component_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of an individual component item included in this bundle. References the product master catalog.

attributes.name: component_substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component can be substituted with an equivalent item during fulfillment (e.g., out-of-stock scenarios, mix-and-match bundles).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bundle configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for bundle pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar discount applied to the component sum when pricing_method is discount_amount.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the component sum when pricing_method is discount_percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this bundle configuration expires or is discontinued. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this bundle configuration becomes active and available for sale across all channels.

attributes.name: inventory_deduction_method
attributes.description: Defines how inventory is tracked and decremented: component_level (deduct each component SKU), bundle_level (track bundle as single inventory unit), hybrid (track both bundle and components).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bundle configuration record was last updated.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can earn loyalty program points on bundle purchases.

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum number of bundle units a customer can purchase in a single transaction. Used to prevent stockouts and ensure fair distribution of limited-time offers.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum number of bundle units a customer must purchase in a single transaction. Typically 1, but may be higher for wholesale or bulk bundles.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this bundle configuration. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Defines how the bundle price is calculated: bundle_price (fixed price for entire bundle), component_sum (sum of individual component prices), discount_percentage (percentage off component sum), discount_amount (fixed dollar discount off component sum).

attributes.name: promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle can be included in additional promotional offers or discounts beyond its configured bundle pricing.

attributes.name: return_policy_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the specific return policy applicable to this bundle (e.g., standard 30-day, final sale, exchange only).

attributes.name: returnable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bundle can be returned. Some bundles (e.g., opened gift sets, perishable meal kits) may not be returnable.

products.name: gtin_registry
products.description: Authoritative registry of all Global Trade Item Numbers (GTINs) including UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, EAN-8, and ITF-14 barcodes associated with each SKU. Captures GTIN value, GTIN type (UPC, EAN, GTIN-14), SKU reference, issuing GS1 company prefix, barcode image reference, packaging level (unit, inner pack, case, pallet), parent GTIN reference (self-referencing for packaging hierarchy — e.g., case GTIN contains N unit GTINs), child GTIN count per parent, and registration status. Models the full GS1 packaging hierarchy enabling warehouse receiving at case level to resolve to constituent unit GTINs. Aligned with GS1 global standards. Supports EDI transactions (ASN, PO, invoice), warehouse receiving, POS scanning, and GDSN data synchronization.

attributes.name: gtin_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Registry ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GTIN registry record. Primary key for the GTIN registry product.

tag_set.value: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Registry ID

attributes.name: gtin_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: gtin_registry.sku_code (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK. GTINs are registered for specific SKUs - this is the authoritative link between global trade item numbers and internal SKU master.

attributes.name: net_content_uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: gtin_registry.net_content_unit is a STRING column storing a denormalized unit of measure for net content (e.g., 'oz', 'ml', 'g'). The uom table contains gs1_uom_code which directly maps to GS1 standar

attributes.name: barcode_image_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the digital barcode image asset (PNG, SVG, or EPS format). Used for printing labels, packaging artwork, and digital commerce applications. Points to asset management system or CDN location.

attributes.name: barcode_symbology
attributes.description: The barcode encoding standard used to represent this GTIN. EAN (European Article Number bars), UPC (Universal Product Code bars), ITF-14 (Interleaved 2 of 5 for cases), GS1-128 (application identifier barcodes), QR (2D matrix code). Determines scanner compatibility.

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: The final digit of the GTIN calculated using GS1 check digit algorithm (modulo 10). Used to validate GTIN integrity during scanning and data entry. Automatically calculated but stored for validation purposes.

attributes.name: child_gtin_quantity
attributes.description: Number of child GTINs (next lower packaging level) contained within this GTIN. For example, a case GTIN with child_gtin_quantity=24 contains 24 unit GTINs. Null for unit-level GTINs. Used to calculate inventory at different packaging levels.

attributes.name: country_of_sale
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this GTIN is authorized for sale. A single SKU may have different GTINs for different countries due to regulatory labeling requirements. For example, USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU, FRA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GTIN registry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Immutable after initial creation.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this GTIN is retired and should no longer be used in new transactions. Null for active GTINs. Used for product lifecycle management and to prevent ordering of discontinued items. Historical transactions retain the GTIN for audit purposes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this GTIN becomes active and can be used in transactions. For new product launches, this is the go-live date. For packaging changes, this is when the new GTIN replaces the old one. Critical for supply chain cutover planning.

attributes.name: gdsn_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful synchronization of this GTIN data to the GDSN data pool. Used to track data freshness and identify GTINs requiring re-publication after attribute changes.

attributes.name: gdsn_publication_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Data Synchronization Network (GDSN) Publication Status
attributes.description: Status of this GTIN in the GS1 Global Data Synchronization Network. Published (live in GDSN data pool), unpublished (not yet shared), pending (awaiting data pool validation), synchronized (confirmed by trading partners), rejected (validation errors). Required for supplier collaboration and EDI.

tag_set.value: Global Data Synchronization Network (GDSN) Publication Status

attributes.name: gross_weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross_weight_value. Typically g (gram), kg (kilogram), oz (ounce), or lb (pound). Must be consistent across supply chain for accurate logistics planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List

attributes.name: gross_weight_value
attributes.description: Total weight of the packaged item including product and packaging materials. Used for shipping calculations, freight costing, and warehouse capacity planning. Measured in gross_weight_unit.

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: The GS1-issued company prefix portion of the GTIN. Identifies the brand owner or manufacturer who registered this GTIN with GS1. Typically 6-12 digits depending on the company size and GS1 member organization.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The actual GTIN barcode value. Can be 8-digit (EAN-8, UPC-E), 12-digit (UPC-A), 13-digit (EAN-13), or 14-digit (GTIN-14/ITF-14) format. This is the scannable barcode number used at POS, warehouse receiving, and throughout the supply chain.

attributes.name: gtin_type
attributes.description: The specific GTIN format type. UPC-A (12-digit North America standard), UPC-E (8-digit compressed UPC), EAN-13 (13-digit international standard), EAN-8 (8-digit short EAN), GTIN-14 (14-digit case/pallet level), ITF-14 (Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode for GTIN-14).

attributes.name: is_base_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN is the base unit of measure for inventory tracking. Typically true for the smallest sellable unit (each). All other packaging levels are multiples of the base unit. Used for inventory conversion calculations.

attributes.name: is_consumer_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents a consumer-facing unit sold at POS. True for retail each units. False for case/pallet GTINs used only in supply chain. Determines whether GTIN should appear in e-commerce catalog and POS systems.

attributes.name: is_orderable_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN can be ordered directly via EDI purchase orders. True for case and pallet GTINs typically ordered from suppliers. False for unit GTINs that are only sold at retail. Controls EDI transaction validation.

attributes.name: is_variable_measure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents a variable measure item (e.g., meat, produce, cheese sold by weight). True for items where price varies by weight/quantity. Affects POS scanning behavior and pricing logic.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications - Variable Measure Items

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this GTIN registry record. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used to track data freshness and trigger downstream synchronization processes.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this GTIN registry record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Links to identity management system for user details.

attributes.name: net_content_value
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of product contained in this GTIN package. For example, 500 (when unit is mL), 12 (when unit is oz), 1.5 (when unit is kg). Used with net_content_unit to describe package size. Required for GDSN synchronization.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Synchronization Network (GDSN) Standard

attributes.name: package_depth_value
attributes.description: Depth dimension of the package. Used with height and width for cubic volume calculations. Essential for warehouse bin sizing and transportation load planning. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: package_dimension_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for package dimensions (height, width, depth). Standard units: mm (millimeter), cm (centimeter), m (meter), in (inch), ft (foot). Must be consistent for all three dimensions.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List

attributes.name: package_height_value
attributes.description: Height dimension of the package. Used with package_width_value and package_depth_value to calculate cubic volume for warehouse slotting, transportation planning, and shelf space allocation. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: package_width_value
attributes.description: Width dimension of the package. Critical for planogram design, shelf allocation, and transportation cube optimization. Measured in package_dimension_unit.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: The packaging hierarchy level this GTIN represents. Unit (each/consumer unit), inner pack (multi-pack sold as one), case (shipping carton), pallet (full pallet load), display (retail display shipper). Critical for warehouse receiving and inventory management.

attributes.name: parent_gtin
attributes.description: Self-referencing GTIN that represents the next higher packaging level in the hierarchy. For example, a unit GTIN's parent would be the case GTIN. Null for the highest packaging level (typically pallet). Enables resolution of case receipts to constituent unit GTINs.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this GTIN registration. Active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (awaiting approval), suspended (compliance issue), retired (permanently discontinued). Controls whether the GTIN can be used in transactions.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN meets all applicable regulatory requirements for its country of sale. Compliant (approved for sale), non_compliant (blocked), pending_review (under evaluation), exempt (not subject to specific regulations). Enforced by quality assurance and legal teams.

attributes.name: replacement_gtin
attributes.description: The new GTIN that supersedes this one when discontinued. Used for packaging changes, reformulations, or product transitions. Enables automatic substitution in ordering systems and maintains continuity in assortment planning.

products.name: uom
products.description: Unit of measure reference master defining all valid units (each, case, pallet, pound, kilogram, liter, ounce) and conversion factors used across ordering, inventory, pricing, and distribution. Captures UOM code, description, UOM class (weight, volume, count, length), base UOM conversion factor, and GS1 standard mapping.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit of measure. Primary key for the UOM reference master.

attributes.name: base_uom_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on uom (base_uom_id)

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Classification of the unit of measure by measurement type: weight (mass), volume (capacity), count (discrete units), length (distance), area (surface), or time (duration).

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, LB for pound, KG for kilogram). Used as the business identifier across ordering, inventory, pricing, and distribution systems.

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier to convert this unit of measure to the base unit. For example, if 1 case = 12 each, the conversion factor is 12. A value of 1 indicates this is the base unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit of measure record was first created in the master data system. Part of audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of this unit of measure record based on Master Data Management (MDM) data quality rules and validation checks.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the unit of measure, including usage context and business rules for application across retail operations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this unit of measure is no longer valid for new transactions. Null indicates no planned end date. Part of temporal validity tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this unit of measure becomes valid and available for use across retail systems. Part of temporal validity tracking.

attributes.name: gs1_uom_code
attributes.description: Standardized GS1 unit of measure code used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and global supply chain interoperability. Maps internal UOM codes to GS1 standards.

attributes.name: inverse_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Reciprocal of the conversion factor, used for reverse conversions from base unit to this unit. Calculated as 1 divided by conversion_factor.

attributes.name: is_base_unit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the base unit of measure in its class (True) or a derived/alternate unit (False). Base units have a conversion factor of 1.

attributes.name: is_consumer_unit
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure represents a consumer-facing selling unit (True for each, single item, False for case, pallet, or bulk units).

attributes.name: is_fractional_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether fractional quantities are permitted for this unit of measure (True for weight/volume units like pounds or liters, False for discrete count units like cases or pallets).

attributes.name: is_inventory_tracked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether inventory quantities are tracked and managed in this unit of measure (True if used in Warehouse Management System (WMS) and inventory systems, False if conversion-only).

attributes.name: is_orderable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure can be used for purchase order creation and supplier ordering (True if valid for procurement, False if display-only or internal-use).

attributes.name: is_variable_measure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this unit of measure is used for variable-weight or variable-measure items (True for items sold by weight or volume with varying quantities, False for fixed-count items).

attributes.name: iso_uom_code
attributes.description: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) unit code per ISO 80000 and ISO 31 standards, ensuring global consistency in measurement representation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit of measure record was most recently updated. Part of audit trail for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit of measure: active (in use), inactive (not currently used but retained for historical data), deprecated (being phased out), or pending (awaiting approval for use).

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the data steward or system user who last modified this unit of measure record. Part of audit trail for accountability and data governance.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure (e.g., Each, Case, Pound, Kilogram, Liter, Ounce, Pallet).

attributes.name: precision_decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which quantities in this unit of measure should be rounded for display and calculation purposes (e.g., 0 for whole units like cases, 2 for currency-like precision, 3 for weight measurements).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of units of measure in user interfaces and reports. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: superseded_by_uom_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Unit of Measure (UOM) Code
attributes.description: Code of the replacement unit of measure that supersedes this one when deprecated. Used to maintain continuity during UOM transitions and system migrations.

tag_set.value: Superseded By Unit of Measure (UOM) Code

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard abbreviated symbol for the unit of measure (e.g., kg for kilogram, lb for pound, L for liter, oz for ounce). Used in labels, reports, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: unece_code
attributes.description: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UN/ECE) Recommendation 20 unit code, widely used in international trade and customs documentation.

attributes.name: uom_type
attributes.description: Functional type indicating the primary business context where this UOM is used: base (fundamental unit), alternate (conversion unit), display (customer-facing), ordering (procurement), inventory (stock tracking), pricing (selling unit), or shipping (logistics). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base|alternate|display|ordering|inventory|pricing|shipping — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Textual description of the business contexts and operational scenarios where this unit of measure is typically applied (e.g., used for bulk ordering of dry goods, used for pricing fresh produce, used for shipping pallet quantities).

products.name: assortment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of SKUs to fulfillment nodes in the retail network. It captures which products are authorized to be stocked at which locations, along with node-specific inventory policies, allocation rules, and stocking parameters. Each record links one SKU to one fulfillment node with attributes that govern how that SKU is managed at that specific location. This is the authoritative source for product assortment decisions and location-specific inventory control parameters.. Existence Justification: In retail omnichannel operations, a single SKU is stocked across multiple fulfillment nodes (distribution centers, stores acting as ship-from-store locations, micro-fulfillment centers, dark stores), and each node carries thousands of different SKUs. The business actively manages these SKU-to-node assignments through assortment planning processes, setting node-specific inventory policies, allocation priorities, and stocking parameters for each SKU at each location. This is a core operational relationship managed by merchandising and supply chain teams.

attributes.name: assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this SKU-to-node assortment assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.cluster. Business justification: Retail clusters group stores with similar assortment strategies (urban vs suburban, high-income vs value-oriented). Assortment plans are built at cluster level then deployed to member locations. Enabl

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Department managers plan and execute assortments within their departments for space allocation, fixture planning, and merchandising standards. Assortment at department level drives planogram creation,

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.format. Business justification: Store formats (hypermarket, supermarket, convenience, discount) have fundamentally different assortment strategies driven by space, target customer, and operating model. Assortment plans are designed

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fulfillment node master record. Identifies which location is authorized to stock this SKU.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.location. Business justification: Retail assortment planning assigns specific SKUs to specific store locations based on format, demographics, and space. Assortment.assortment_sku_id defines WHAT is carried; assortment_location_id defi

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Location-SKU assortment planning requires preferred vendor designation for direct-store-delivery (DSD) routing, vendor-managed inventory (VMI) programs, and multi-source replenishment decisions. Criti

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU master record. Identifies which product is assigned to this fulfillment node.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for inventory allocation when supply is constrained. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest priority). Used by allocation engines to determine which nodes receive inventory first during shortages. Typically based on sales velocity, strategic importance, or customer service level agreements.

attributes.name: assignment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first authorized to be stocked at this node. Marks the beginning of the assortment assignment. Used for assortment history tracking and performance analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was removed from the authorized assortment at this node. Null for currently active assignments. Used for assortment history and discontinued product tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment assignment record was last updated. Tracks changes to stocking status, min/max quantities, or other assignment parameters.

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was last received into inventory at this node. Used to identify slow-moving or stale inventory, support FIFO/FEFO rotation, and flag potential obsolescence. Updated by warehouse management system upon receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: max_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory quantity that should be stocked at this node for this SKU. Prevents overstocking and ensures efficient use of storage capacity. Set based on storage constraints, demand forecasts, and inventory turn targets. Node-specific based on storage capacity and sales velocity.

attributes.name: min_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity that should be maintained at this node for this SKU. Triggers replenishment when on-hand inventory falls below this threshold. Set based on lead time demand, safety stock calculations, and service level targets. Node-specific based on local demand patterns.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to replenish this SKU at this specific node from the time a replenishment order is placed. Includes order processing, picking, packing, transit, and receiving time. Node-specific based on distance from supply source, transportation mode, and receiving capacity.

attributes.name: stocking_status
attributes.description: Current stocking status of this SKU at this specific node. ACTIVE (currently stocked and replenished), DISCONTINUED (no longer carried at this location), SEASONAL (stocked only during specific seasons), CLEARANCE (final inventory selldown), PENDING_SETUP (authorized but not yet received), TEMPORARY_OUT (temporarily not stocked). This is node-specific and can differ from the SKU's global lifecycle_status.

domains.name: order
domains.description: Manages omnichannel order lifecycle from cart creation through fulfillment including online orders, in-store POS transactions, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS, ship-from-store (SFS), and drop-ship orders. Tracks order headers, line items, payment methods, fulfillment status, delivery tracking, and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization). Integrates with OMS for end-to-end order orchestration.

products.name: header
products.description: Core master record for every omnichannel order. Captures order number, channel origin (web, app, call center, marketplace), order date/time, customer reference, fulfillment node reference (FK to store/distribution domain), order status, currency, locale, totals (subtotal, tax, discount, shipping, grand total), OMS reference ID, source system, and audit timestamps. SSOT for order identity and lifecycle. Carrier and fulfillment node masters are owned by peer domains and referenced via cross-domain FK.

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within an order header. Supports split-fulfillment where different lines ship from different nodes.

products.description: Point-of-Sale transaction record for in-store purchase events at registers. Captures POS terminal ID, register number, cashier/associate ID, store number, transaction date/time, transaction type (sale, return, exchange, void), total tender, tax, discount, loyalty card number, basket metrics (item count, UPT, ATV), and fiscal receipt number. SSOT for brick-and-mortar register transactions. Complements order_header for transactions originating at physical registers rather than digital order flow. Payment tenders linked via the payment product.

attributes.name: promotion_count

attributes.name: receipt_phone

attributes.description: Total quantity of all items purchased in the transaction, summed across all line items. May differ from item_count when multiple units of the same SKU are purchased.

attributes.name: training_mode_flag

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable transaction number printed on the customer receipt. Externally visible identifier for customer service and returns processing.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POS transaction indicating whether it was completed, voided, suspended for later completion, or refunded.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was completed at the register. Primary business event timestamp for sales analytics and footfall analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of POS transaction distinguishing between sales, returns, exchanges, voids, and no-sale register opens.

attributes.name: void_reason_code

Supports basket analysis and sell-through rate calculations.

attributes.name: return_reason_code

attributes.name: scanned_timestamp

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit identifier for the product sold. Used for inventory tracking and assortment management.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged for this line item. Calculated by applying the tax rate to the net line amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and category code for this line item. Determines applicable sales tax rate based on product category and location.

attributes.name: tax_rate

attributes.name: total_line_amount

attributes.name: unit_retail_price

attributes.name: upc

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding this line item. Used for shrinkage analysis and operational improvement.

attributes.name: voided_flag

products.name: payment
products.description: Payment tender record capturing each payment instrument applied to an order or POS transaction. Stores payment method type (credit card, debit, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL, cash, digital wallet), masked PAN/token, payment processor reference, authorization code, settlement status (authorized, captured, settled, declined, voided), payment amount, currency, tender sequence for split-tender scenarios, PCI DSS tokenization reference, fraud score, and 3DS authentication result. Supports split-tender where multiple payment methods cover a single order total. Integrates with PCI SSC compliance requirements and payment gateway APIs.
products.reference: OMS Payment / PCI DSS Payment Record

attributes.name: authorization_code

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp

attributes.name: avs_result_code

attributes.name: bnpl_provider

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds marked for settlement). Typically occurs at order fulfillment or shipment.

attributes.name: card_expiry_year

attributes.name: cardholder_name

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes web, mobile app, in-store POS (Point of Sale), call center, kiosk, or third-party platform.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
