attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of promotional inventory sold during the promotion period. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 85.50 for 85.5%). Indicates inventory velocity.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The specific product SKU included in this promotion performance measurement. Enables product-level promotion effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: unique_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct customers who purchased the promoted item during the period. Measures promotion reach.

attributes.name: units_per_transaction
attributes.description: Average number of units of the promoted SKU purchased per transaction. Indicates promotion-driven purchase intensity.

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of units sold during the promotion period for this SKU at this store. Core volume metric for promotion effectiveness.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount funded by the vendor/supplier as part of co-op or trade promotion agreement. Used for vendor settlement and chargeback processing.

products.name: promo_calendar
products.description: Master record for the retail promotional calendar defining planned promotional periods, key retail events, blackout dates, and competitive response windows for a fiscal year. Captures period name, period type (weekly ad cycle, seasonal event, holiday, clearance window, competitive response), start/end dates, fiscal week/month/quarter alignment, priority tier, planning lock date, planning status (draft, locked, active, archived), and banner/market applicability for multi-banner retailers. Used by merchandising, marketing, and supply chain teams to coordinate promotional activity, inventory positioning, and circular production timelines. Serves as the shared planning backbone that prevents promotional conflicts and ensures adequate lead time for vendor negotiations and inventory builds. Supports multi-banner coordination by allowing banner-specific or enterprise-wide calendar periods.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional calendar period. Primary key for the promotional calendar master record.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Promotional calendars are region-specific — different regions have distinct blackout periods, fiscal calendars, and promotional cadences. promo_calendar.applicable_market_codes is a denormalized text

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Promotional calendar periods align with merchandising seasons. Planning requires synchronized timing for new season launches, mid-season promotions, and end-of-season clearance. Critical for coordinat

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Digital promotional calendar scoping: promo calendars governing digital-only events (Cyber Monday, flash sales, app-exclusive sale windows) need storefront reference for digital planning, publication

attributes.name: applicable_banner_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of banner codes to which this promotional period applies. Populated only when banner_applicability is 'banner_specific'.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional calendar period was formally approved by management. Null if still pending approval.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether executive or senior management approval is required for promotions during this period (true) or standard approval workflows apply (false).

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who approved this promotional calendar period.

attributes.name: banner_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional period applies across all retail banners (enterprise-wide) or is specific to individual banners (banner-specific). Supports multi-banner coordination.

attributes.name: blackout_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for why this period is designated as a promotional blackout (e.g., inventory transition, system maintenance, post-holiday recovery).

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this promotional period including markdown funding, advertising spend, and vendor co-op contributions.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the promotional budget amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which sales channels this promotional period applies to (omnichannel, store-only, e-commerce-only, mobile-app-only).

attributes.name: circular_production_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which all promotional circular materials (print ads, digital circulars) must be finalized for production and distribution.

attributes.name: competitive_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional period was created as a competitive response to rival retailer promotions (true) or is part of the planned calendar (false).

attributes.name: competitive_trigger_description
attributes.description: Description of the competitive market event or rival promotion that triggered this promotional period. Populated when competitive_response_flag is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional calendar record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period ends. Defines the effective end of promotional activity and pricing.

attributes.name: expected_sales_lift_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage increase in sales revenue expected during this promotional period compared to baseline or prior year.

attributes.name: expected_traffic_lift_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage increase in customer traffic (footfall and digital visits) expected during this promotional period compared to baseline.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month (1-12) to which this promotional period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1-4) to which this promotional period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: The fiscal week number (1-52 or 1-53) to which this promotional period belongs, aligned with the retail 4-5-4 calendar.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this promotional period belongs (e.g., 2024, 2025).

attributes.name: inventory_build_start_date
attributes.description: The date when inventory positioning and build-up for this promotional period should begin to ensure adequate stock levels.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar period is currently active and valid (true) or has been logically deleted or superseded (false).

attributes.name: is_blackout_period
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this period is a promotional blackout window where no new promotions should be launched (true) or a normal promotional period (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional calendar record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: market_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the promotional period indicating whether it applies nationally, regionally, or to specific local markets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding special considerations, constraints, or coordination requirements for this promotional period.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the promotional period (e.g., 'Spring Sale 2024', 'Black Friday Week', 'Back to School August').

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional period indicating the nature and purpose of the promotion (weekly ad cycle, seasonal event, holiday, clearance window, competitive response, vendor-funded).

attributes.name: planning_lock_date
attributes.description: The date by which all promotional planning for this period must be finalized and locked. After this date, changes require executive approval.

attributes.name: planning_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the planning owner for coordination and communication regarding this promotional period.

attributes.name: planning_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandising or marketing manager responsible for planning and executing this promotional period.

attributes.name: planning_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional calendar period (draft - under development, locked - finalized for execution, active - currently running, archived - completed and historical).

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority classification of the promotional period indicating strategic importance and resource allocation level (tier 1 strategic, tier 2 major, tier 3 standard, tier 4 tactical).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this promotional calendar record originated (e.g., ORMS, RPM, internal planning tool).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period begins. Defines the effective start of promotional activity and pricing.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer segment or demographic group targeted by this promotional period (e.g., 'families', 'millennials', 'loyalty members', 'value shoppers').

attributes.name: theme_description
attributes.description: Marketing theme or creative concept for the promotional period (e.g., 'Summer Savings', 'Holiday Gift Guide', 'New Year New You').

attributes.name: vendor_negotiation_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which all vendor-funded promotional agreements and co-op advertising commitments must be finalized.

domains.name: supplier
domains.description: Authoritative source for supplier and vendor master data including contact information, contracts, compliance certifications, performance scorecards, chargebacks (vendor compliance penalties), RTV (Return to Vendor) processes, EDI integration, MOQ and lead time agreements, and VMI configurations. Manages supplier onboarding, qualification, risk assessment, and ongoing relationship management for national brands, private label manufacturers, and DSD vendors.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers and vendors including national brand manufacturers, private label producers, DSD vendors, and 3PL partners. Serves as the authoritative golden record for vendor identity, classification, tax identifiers (W-9/W-8), remittance details, business type, ownership structure, diversity certifications, DUNS number, and onboarding status. Contains embedded contact persons (account managers, EDI coordinators, compliance contacts, executive sponsors) with role types, communication preferences, and escalation paths. Contains embedded multi-address records (headquarters, remittance, ship-from, RTV addresses) with geo-coordinates, address validation status, and address type classification. Sourced from the customer master data system and SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1), Informatica MDM Supplier Golden Record

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current master supply agreement or contract with this vendor. Used for contract renewal planning and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the vendor's preferred currency for invoicing and payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: diversity_certification
attributes.description: Diversity certification status of the vendor for supplier diversity programs. MBE (Minority Business Enterprise), WBE (Women Business Enterprise), DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), VBE (Veteran Business Enterprise), LGBTBE (LGBT Business Enterprise), SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business), or none if not certified. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mbe|wbe|dbe|vbe|lgbtbe|sdvosb|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Minority Supplier Development Council (NMSDC), Women's Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC)

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for vendor qualification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated exchange of purchase orders, advance ship notices, invoices, and other business documents. True indicates EDI capability is enabled.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards, SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - EDI Configuration

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: Unique EDI identifier or interchange ID used to route electronic documents to this vendor in EDI transactions (e.g., ISA ID, GS1 GLN).
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards, ANSI X12 Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of ordered quantity that the vendor successfully delivers (order completion percentage). A fill rate of 100% indicates all ordered items were delivered in full.
attributes.references: Vendor Scorecard KPI - Supply Chain Performance

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's general liability and product liability insurance certificate. Used to ensure vendors maintain required insurance coverage as per contract terms.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order issued to this vendor. Used to identify inactive vendors and support vendor rationalization initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order History

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order placement to delivery at the distribution center or store. Used for replenishment planning and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFM1.PLIFZ

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this vendor record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in units that must be ordered from this vendor per purchase order or per SKU (Stock Keeping Unit). Used in procurement planning and order optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - Purchasing Data

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the vendor or supplier as registered with governing authorities. Used for contracts, purchase orders, and legal documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.NAME1

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date. Used in vendor scorecards and supplier performance management.
attributes.references: Vendor Scorecard KPI - Supply Chain Performance

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was officially onboarded and approved for transactions in the vendor master system. Represents the start of the vendor relationship.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Vendor Master Audit Trail

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for remitting payment to the vendor. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for electronic bank transfers, wire transfer for same-day transfers, check for paper checks, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) for direct deposit, credit card for card-based payments, and virtual card for single-use card numbers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master - LFB1.ZWELS

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount conditions for this vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, Net 60). Determines when payment is due and any early payment discounts available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFM1.ZTERM

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for operational communication, order management, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - ADR6.SMTP_ADDR

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization, typically the account manager or sales representative responsible for the business relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - Contact Person

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact person, including country code and extension if applicable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - ADR2.TEL_NUMBER

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of received goods that pass quality inspection and are accepted into inventory without rejection or return. Used to monitor product quality and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: remittance_email
attributes.description: Email address for sending payment remittance advice and electronic payment notifications to the vendor's accounts receivable department.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master - ADR6.SMTP_ADDR

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment rating for the vendor based on financial stability, operational performance, compliance history, and supply chain risk factors. Low indicates minimal risk, medium indicates moderate risk requiring monitoring, high indicates elevated risk requiring mitigation plans, and critical indicates severe risk requiring immediate action or alternative sourcing.

attributes.name: sustainability_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor holds recognized sustainability or environmental certifications (e.g., ISO 14001, B Corp, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance). True indicates the vendor has sustainability credentials.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, B Corporation Certification

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax classification of the vendor for withholding and reporting purposes. W-9 US person indicates a domestic US entity, W-8 foreign entity indicates a non-US entity subject to withholding, exempt organization indicates tax-exempt status, and government entity indicates a governmental body.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The vendor's tax identification number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) used for tax reporting and compliance. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9 / W-8, SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.STCD1

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor in the vendor lifecycle. Active vendors are approved for transactions, inactive vendors are not currently used but remain in the system, suspended vendors are temporarily blocked due to performance or compliance issues, pending approval vendors are undergoing onboarding qualification, blocked vendors cannot transact due to critical issues, and terminated vendors have ended their relationship with the business.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.SPERR

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. National brand manufacturers supply branded products, private label producers manufacture store-brand products, DSD (Direct Store Delivery) vendors deliver directly to stores bypassing distribution centers, 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) partners provide logistics and fulfillment services, service providers offer non-product services, and raw material suppliers provide ingredients or components for private label manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.KTOKK

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this vendor participates in Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs where the vendor monitors inventory levels and initiates replenishment orders. True indicates VMI is active for this vendor.

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Contact persons associated with a vendor including account managers, EDI coordinators, compliance contacts, and executive sponsors. Tracks name, title, role type, phone, email, preferred communication channel, and active status. Supports relationship management and escalation workflows.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Contact (KNVK), Salesforce Service Cloud Contact

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contact person. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor organization this contact represents. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the business address for the vendor contact's office location. Typically includes street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the business address for additional location details such as suite, floor, or building number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor contact's office is located.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact. Inactive or terminated contacts should not receive communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: The functional role or responsibility area of this contact within the vendor organization. Determines escalation paths and communication routing.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor contact's office location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|CHN|JPN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or business unit within the vendor organization where this contact works (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Quality Assurance, Finance).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor contact ceased to be active. Null for currently active contacts. Used for historical tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor contact became active and available for business communications. Supports temporal tracking of contact relationships.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the vendor contact. Used for official communications, purchase orders, and compliance notifications.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the vendor contact, if still used for formal document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: is_escalation_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should be included in escalation workflows for critical issues such as compliance violations, quality failures, or delivery delays.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor. Used for default routing of communications and escalations.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position of the contact within the vendor organization (e.g., Account Manager, Supply Chain Director, Compliance Officer).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for business communications with this contact. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this vendor contact was engaged in business communication. Used for relationship health monitoring and engagement tracking.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor contact record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the vendor contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent escalations and time-sensitive communications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about the vendor contact, such as special instructions, preferences, or relationship history.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The physical office location or site where this contact is based (e.g., headquarters, regional office, manufacturing plant).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the vendor contact. Includes country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor contact's office location.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method for receiving business communications. Supports personalized engagement and improved response rates.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the vendor contact's office is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone where the vendor contact is located. Used for scheduling meetings and understanding business hours. Format follows IANA Time Zone Database (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

products.name: vendor_address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses for vendors including headquarters, remittance, ship-from, and returns (RTV) addresses. Tracks address type, street, city, state, postal code, country, geo-coordinates, and validation status. Supports procurement, logistics routing, and RTV processing.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Address (ADRC), GS1 Location Number (GLN)

attributes.name: vendor_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom this address belongs. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, department, or additional location details. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for complex addresses requiring additional location specification. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label for the address location (e.g., 'Main Distribution Center', 'Corporate HQ', 'Returns Processing Facility').

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address: active (in use), inactive (no longer used), pending_validation (awaiting verification), invalid (failed validation), temporary (short-term use).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: headquarters (corporate office), remittance (payment processing), ship_from (origin for DSD or shipments), returns (RTV processing location), billing (invoice address), warehouse (distribution or storage facility).

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for the location, used for business identity verification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management. 9-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address is no longer valid or was deactivated. Null indicates the address is currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became active and valid for use in procurement, logistics, and vendor transactions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the address location, used for logistics coordination, RTV notifications, and operational communication. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the address location, used for EDI transmission or document exchange with vendors. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the physical location for EDI transactions, logistics routing, and supply chain integration. 13-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: is_dsd_location

attributes.name: is_primary_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary or default address for the vendor. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_remittance_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is used for payment remittance and accounts payable processing. True if remittance address, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_rtv_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is designated for RTV (Return to Vendor) processing and merchandise returns. True if RTV address, False otherwise. Critical for reverse logistics and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified or updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-specific information, special delivery instructions, access requirements, or operational notes for logistics and procurement teams.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the address location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit ZIP in USA, alphanumeric in Canada). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional subdivision where the address is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or district code applicable to this address location, used for sales tax calculation, VAT compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London). Supports scheduling, delivery windows, and cross-timezone coordination.

attributes.name: validation_date

attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS Address Validation API, Canada Post AddressComplete, UPS Address Validation, manual verification).

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: line_review_date

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Milestones

attributes.name: markdown_entry_date

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Markdown Calendar

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the season (e.g., Spring/Summer 2024, Holiday 2024, Back-to-School 2024). Human-readable label for business users.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Master

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, strategic notes, or special considerations for the season (e.g., market trends, competitive landscape, promotional themes). Used by merchandising planners.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Master

attributes.name: otb_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total Open to Buy budget allocated for this season in the base currency. Represents the planned purchase commitment for merchandise. Critical for financial planning and vendor negotiations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - OTB Planning

attributes.name: planning_start_date
attributes.description: The date when pre-season planning activities begin, including assortment planning, OTB (Open to Buy) budget allocation, and category strategy development.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Planning

attributes.name: season_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the season. Planning: pre-season planning phase. Open-to-Buy: OTB budgets active, buying in progress. In-Season: merchandise on floor, active selling. Post-Season: season ended, analysis and clearance. Closed: season archived.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Master

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Classification of the season by merchandising cycle (e.g., spring/summer, fall/winter, holiday, back-to-school). Drives assortment planning and buying strategies.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the season officially begins for merchandising and planning purposes. Marks the start of in-season operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Season Master

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)

attributes.name: target_inventory_turns

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Updated in near-real-time as buying orders are placed. The authoritative record for whether a buyer has remaining budget authority to commit new purchases. Sourced from ORMS and reconciled with SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: otb_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category within the department for which this OTB budget applies. Categories provide finer product segmentation (e.g., Men's Shirts, Laptops, Bedding).

attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise season or planning period for which this OTB budget is allocated (e.g., Spring 2024, Holiday 2024, Back-to-School 2024).

attributes.name: actual_receipts_at_cost
attributes.description: The total actual merchandise receipts at cost that have been received into inventory during this budget period. Updated as goods receipts are posted from purchase orders.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the OTB budget. Pending = awaiting review; Approved = authorized for buyer use; Rejected = not approved and requires revision.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTB budget was approved. Marks the point at which the budget became active and available for buyer commitments.

attributes.description: The remaining budget balance available for new purchase commitments. Calculated as: Planned Receipts + Adjustments - Actual Receipts - Committed Amount. This is the authoritative field that determines whether a buyer can place new orders.

attributes.name: budget_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative net adjustment to the original planned receipts budget. Includes increases, decreases, and transfers from other budgets. Positive values increase available OTB; negative values decrease it.

attributes.name: budget_decrease_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of budget decreases applied to this OTB budget. Decreases may occur due to lower-than-expected sales, inventory overstock, or strategic reallocation to other categories.

attributes.description: The effective end date of the OTB budget period. After this date, the budget is typically closed and no further commitments are allowed unless extended.

attributes.name: budget_increase_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of budget increases applied to this OTB budget. Increases are typically approved by senior merchandising leadership to support higher-than-planned demand or strategic opportunities.

attributes.name: budget_name

attributes.name: budget_number

attributes.description: The total amount of budget transferred out of this OTB budget to other budgets. Recorded as a positive value; reduces the available OTB balance of this budget.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount committed on open purchase orders that have not yet been received. Also known as on-order amount. Represents future obligations against the OTB budget.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OTB budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this OTB budget are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which this OTB budget is allocated. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this OTB budget applies (e.g., 2024). Used for multi-year budget tracking and financial planning alignment.

attributes.name: gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: The target GMROI ratio for this OTB budget. GMROI measures the gross margin dollars returned for every dollar invested in inventory. Used to evaluate buying efficiency and profitability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

For new item onboarding: setup status, go-live date, required attributes checklist, compliance certifications (CPSC, FDA), UPC/GTIN registration status. For discontinuation: reason (low sell-through, supplier exit, assortment rationalization, dead stock), last order date, clearance strategy, and final disposition. The authoritative record of what is carried where and its complete lifecycle state.

domains.name: ecommerce
domains.description: Manages digital commerce operations including online storefronts, product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows, digital payment processing, session tracking, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), AOV (Average Order Value), and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). Tracks digital customer journeys, abandoned carts, and online-to-offline attribution. Integrates with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for unified digital commerce platform.

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront or online channel operated by Retail, including the main e-commerce site, mobile app storefronts, and marketplace presences. Captures storefront identity, locale, currency, domain URL, platform configuration (the e-commerce platform site ID, channel-specific settings, feature flags, theme/template references), launch date, status, supported payment methods, and supported fulfillment modes (BOPIS, ship-to-home, drop-ship). SSOT for digital channel identity and configuration within the e-commerce domain. Domain ownership principle: the ecommerce domain owns digital commerce operations from storefront configuration through checkout completion. Customer identity is owned by the customer domain; post-checkout order lifecycle is owned by the order domain; promotional campaign definitions are owned by the promotion domain; product master data is owned by the product domain.

attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FTC — Pricing Transparency Requirements; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Tax Configuration

attributes.name: theme_code
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the visual theme or template applied to this storefront within the e-commerce platform (e.g., 'sfra-retail-v3', 'pwa-kit-2024'). Controls the storefront's UI/UX presentation layer, including layout, typography, and brand styling. Used by digital merchandising and visual merchandising teams for planogram-equivalent digital shelf configuration.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Storefront Reference Architecture (SFRA) Documentation

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the storefront's primary operating time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling promotional campaigns, flash sales, maintenance windows, and business-hours-based SLA calculations. Aligns with the e-commerce platform site time zone configuration.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; NRF — Digital Commerce Operations Standards

products.name: digital_catalog
products.description: E-commerce product catalog record representing the published, channel-specific view of merchandise available on a given storefront. Tracks which SKUs are active online, digital content completeness (images, descriptions, rich media), SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical URL), online availability flags, digital-only pricing overrides, and publication status. This is the digital presentation layer — distinct from the master product catalog in the product domain which owns canonical SKU/UPC definitions and the master merchandise hierarchy.

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each digital catalog record representing a channel-specific published view of a SKU on a given storefront. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a digital presentation asset managed and published via the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_item. Business justification: Digital catalog entries are online manifestation of merchandising assortment decisions. Merchandisers measure assortment plan execution online, track which planned items are published and performing,

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: E-commerce platforms generate brand landing pages, enable brand filtering, track brand-level conversion metrics, and execute brand-specific promotions. Proper FK replaces denormalized brand_name, enab

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers manage online assortment, pricing strategy, and product content decisions for their assigned categories. Digital catalog accountability and performance reporting require buyer attribution for m

attributes.name: digital_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary digital storefront category (navigation taxonomy node) under which this SKU is merchandised online. May differ from the master merchandise hierarchy in ORMS to reflect digital-specific category management and assortment breadth strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Category Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: digital_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Online catalog displays store-level availability for BOPIS and ship-from-store fulfillment options. Enables "available at nearby stores" feature and store inventory lookup for omnichannel shoppers.

attributes.name: digital_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Products displayed online show store-specific availability and fulfillment options. Real business process: "check store availability" feature, store-specific assortment display, local inventory querie

attributes.name: digital_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Catalog publishing process requires authoritative link to product master for attributes, compliance flags, lifecycle status, vendor data, and pricing rules. Retail operations depend on single source o

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Catalog managers run 'catalog price list assignment' reports to ensure the correct price list governs each digital product's displayed price. digital_catalog has sku_price_id but not the governing pri

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Product pages display active promotions; linking enables merchandising teams to verify promotional pricing accuracy across catalog, SEO teams to optimize promotional landing pages, and compliance team

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Digital merchandising offer association: online product listings are tied to specific promotional offers (featured deal banners, BOGO callouts, limited-time offer badges). Linking digital_catalog to p

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Online catalog organized by retail seasons (Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, Holiday). Seasonal merchandising drives publish/unpublish schedules, promotional calendars, and assortment planning. Critical fo

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Digital catalog product pages must display authoritative online prices from sku_price, which maintains channel-specific and zone-specific pricing. Core business process: e-commerce price display and c

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Catalog managers suppress or publish listings based on stock position (is_online_available, publication_status decisions). Direct FK enables real-time ATP-driven catalog availability management — a co

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Drop-ship and private-label digital catalog content sourcing: content teams pull vendor item specs (GTIN, EAN, pack config, country of origin) to populate digital listings. This link enables 'which ve

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age-gating requirement for this SKU on the digital storefront, applicable to regulated product categories such as alcohol, tobacco, and certain pharmaceuticals. Drives age verification workflows at checkout. Regulated by FTC and FDA.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection; FDA — Age-Restricted Product Sales; CPSC — Product Safety

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: The canonical URL of the product detail page (PDP) used to prevent duplicate content issues across multiple storefront URLs or faceted navigation paths. Declared in the HTML link rel=canonical tag. Managed in the e-commerce platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: content_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00–100.00) measuring how complete the digital content is for this catalog record, based on presence of required fields such as title, description, images, SEO metadata, and rich media. Used to prioritize content enrichment efforts and improve Conversion Rate (CR).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Content Quality Scoring; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and content age analysis. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Audit; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the online_price for this digital catalog record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency storefronts in international e-commerce operations.

attributes.name: has_video
attributes.description: Indicates whether at least one product video (e.g., demonstration, unboxing, lifestyle) is published for this SKU on the storefront. Rich media presence is a key driver of Conversion Rate (CR) improvement in digital commerce.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Rich Media Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU contains hazardous materials subject to special shipping, handling, or labeling requirements. Affects last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier selection in the Order Management System (OMS). Regulated by CPSC and OSHA.
attributes.references: CPSC — Hazardous Substance Regulations; OSHA — Hazardous Materials Handling

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: Total number of product images published for this SKU on the storefront, including hero, alternate angles, lifestyle, and swatch images. Used to measure digital content completeness and identify SKUs requiring additional imagery.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Digital Asset Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is fulfilled via Drop Ship, where the vendor ships directly to the customer without passing through a Distribution Center (DC). Relevant for extended aisle and marketplace assortment strategies.
attributes.references: NRF — Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and Drop Ship Standards

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been manually designated as a featured product by digital merchandisers, qualifying it for placement in featured product carousels, homepage spotlights, or category hero positions on the storefront.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Merchandising Rules; NRF — Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: is_online_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for purchase on the digital storefront. Distinct from publication_status — a product may be published but temporarily unavailable due to inventory depletion or fulfillment constraints. Drives add-to-cart eligibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Inventory Availability; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product owned and sold exclusively by the retailer. Private label products typically carry higher gross margins and are a key strategic differentiator in assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Assortment Planning; NRF — Private Label Standards

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is indexed and returned in on-site search results on the digital storefront. A product may be published but excluded from search (e.g., exclusive landing page products or clearance items managed via direct URL only).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Index Configuration

attributes.name: last_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently published or re-published to the live storefront. Used for content freshness tracking, cache invalidation, and audit trails in the e-commerce platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Publish History; ISO 27001 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code specifying the language and regional variant for this digital catalog record (e.g., en-US, fr-CA, es-MX). Supports multi-locale storefront content management and international e-commerce operations in the e-commerce platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Localization; IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Full consumer-facing product description displayed on the product detail page (PDP), including features, benefits, materials, and usage instructions. Supports rich HTML formatting. Managed in the e-commerce platform content management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Detail Page (PDP); FDA — Food Labeling Requirements (for grocery SKUs)

attributes.name: primary_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the primary hero product image displayed on the product detail page (PDP) and product listing pages (PLP). Hosted on the digital asset management (DAM) system or CDN. Critical for digital content completeness scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Digital Asset Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The consumer-facing product title as displayed on the digital storefront. May differ from the master product name in PIM to reflect channel-specific merchandising copy or A/B tested titles. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Detail Page (PDP); NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital catalog record on the storefront. Controls whether the SKU is visible and purchasable by online shoppers. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|published|unpublished|scheduled|archived|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Management; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: publish_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to be or was deactivated and removed from the storefront. Used for seasonal assortment management, limited-time offers, and clearance markdown lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Scheduling; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: publish_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital catalog record is scheduled to become or became active and visible on the storefront. Used for pre-launch product scheduling and promotional launch coordination in the e-commerce platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Catalog Scheduling; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: rating_average
attributes.description: Average customer review rating for this SKU on the digital storefront, on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Aggregated from verified purchase reviews. Used in product ranking algorithms, content completeness scoring, and conversion rate optimization analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Ratings and Reviews; NRF — Customer Experience Standards

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of published customer reviews for this SKU on the digital storefront. Used alongside rating_average to assess review volume credibility and identify SKUs requiring review generation campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Ratings and Reviews; FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines

attributes.name: seo_meta_description
attributes.description: The HTML meta description tag for the product detail page (PDP), summarizing the product for search engine result snippets. Typically 150-160 characters. Drives organic Click-Through Rate (CTR) from search engine results pages.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: seo_title
attributes.description: The HTML page title tag for the product detail page (PDP), optimized for search engine indexing. Typically limited to 60 characters per SEO best practices. Managed in the e-commerce platform content management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing product description displayed in product listing pages (PLP) and search results. Typically 100-200 characters. Sourced from the e-commerce platform product content and may differ from the master description in PIM.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Information Management (PIM) Integration; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric position used to control the default display sequence of this SKU within its assigned digital category on the storefront. Lower values appear first. Used by merchandisers to manually curate product listing page (PLP) rankings.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Merchandising Rules; NRF — Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this digital catalog record originated or was last updated. Supports data lineage tracking across the e-commerce platform (SFCC), the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS), the customer master data system, and the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Master Data Management; ISO 27001 — Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code assigned to this SKU for digital commerce tax calculation purposes, determining applicable sales tax rates at checkout. Mapped to tax engine rules in the e-commerce platform. Relevant for FDA-regulated food items with tax exemptions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FDA — Food Tax Exemption Classifications; FTC — Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently modified, including content updates, price changes, status transitions, or SEO edits. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Audit; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: url_slug
attributes.description: The human-readable URL path segment for the product detail page (PDP), used in constructing the storefront URL. Must be lowercase, hyphen-separated, and unique per storefront. Example: 'mens-slim-fit-chino-pants-navy'.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — URL Management; Google Search Central Guidelines

products.name: web_session
products.description: Tracks individual visitor sessions on digital storefronts, capturing session start/end timestamps, device type, browser, OS, referral source, UTM parameters, landing page, exit page, page view count, session duration, and whether the session resulted in a cart creation, checkout initiation, or completed order. Supports CTR, CR, and digital journey analytics. High-volume event data — recommend 90-day hot retention with archival to cold storage for historical trend analysis.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual visitor session on the digital storefront. Primary key for the web_session data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopping cart created or interacted with during this session. Enables abandoned cart analysis and cart-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution even when no order is placed.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order placed during this session, if is_order_placed is True. Enables direct linkage between digital session analytics and order-level GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.associate. Business justification: Employee purchase programs and associate product training require tracking which associates browse storefronts. Enables employee discount validation, internal traffic filtering from customer analytics

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer associated with this session. Null for anonymous/guest sessions. Enables online-to-offline attribution and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Sessions originate from promotional emails, paid search for promotional keywords, or circular ad QR codes; tracking campaign attribution at session level is fundamental to digital marketing ROI, omnic

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Session-level offer attribution: customers landing via offer-specific URLs (email campaign with embedded offer, SMS promo link) require the session to reference the offer for conversion attribution, A

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or e-commerce site where the session occurred. Supports multi-brand and multi-region digital commerce operations.

attributes.name: browser_name
attributes.description: Name of the web browser used during the session (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Used for compatibility analysis and identifying browser-specific conversion drop-offs in the digital funnel.

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version string of the web browser used during the session. Supports technical compatibility analysis and identification of outdated browser populations impacting checkout CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice or cookie policy presented to the visitor at session start. Enables compliance audit trails demonstrating which consent framework version was in effect at the time of data collection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this web session record was first captured and written to the Silver Layer data product. Distinct from session_start_timestamp which reflects the real-world event time.

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor provided explicit consent for data collection and tracking during this session, as required under GDPR and CCPA. True = consent granted. Governs permissible use of session data for analytics and personalization.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the visitor during the session. Supports omnichannel digital journey analytics and device-specific CR (Conversion Rate) and AOV (Average Order Value) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Device Detection; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the last page viewed before the visitor ended the session. Used to identify drop-off points in the digital funnel and optimize checkout flow to improve CR (Conversion Rate).

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method selected or browsed during the session. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), home_delivery, ship_from_store (SFS), or drop_ship. Supports omnichannel attribution and last-mile delivery analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Fulfillment Options; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code inferred from the visitor's IP address or browser locale. Supports international digital commerce analytics and regional GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the visitor at session initiation. Used for geolocation inference, fraud detection, and bot traffic filtering. May be considered PII under GDPR/CCPA in some jurisdictions. Stored in compliance with data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS Requirement 1

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was identified as automated bot or crawler traffic rather than a genuine human visitor. True = bot session. Used to filter non-human traffic from CR (Conversion Rate), CTR (Click-Through Rate), and Footfall analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Bot Detection; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: is_bounce
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was a bounce — the visitor viewed only a single page and exited without further interaction. True = bounce session. Used to calculate bounce rate as a digital storefront health KPI.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_cart_created
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor created a shopping cart (added at least one item) during this session. True = cart was created. Key funnel stage flag for CR (Conversion Rate) and abandoned cart analysis in the e-commerce platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Management; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_checkout_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor initiated the checkout flow during this session. True = checkout was started. Enables measurement of cart-to-checkout conversion rate and identification of checkout abandonment in the digital funnel.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Checkout Flow; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: is_order_placed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session resulted in a completed order placement. True = order was placed. Primary conversion flag for CR (Conversion Rate) calculation and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution to digital sessions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the first page viewed by the visitor upon entering the digital storefront. Critical for measuring landing page CR (Conversion Rate) and identifying high-performing entry points in the digital customer journey.

attributes.name: last_search_query
attributes.description: The most recent on-site search term entered by the visitor during the session. Supports merchandising and assortment planning by revealing demand signals and zero-result search patterns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Search Analytics; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the visitor's device during the session (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android). Used for device ecosystem analysis and platform-specific performance optimization.

attributes.name: page_view_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct pages viewed by the visitor during the session. Indicator of session engagement depth and product discovery behavior. Used in basket analysis and digital journey analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code entered or applied during the session. Links digital sessions to Pricing and Promotions Management campaigns and enables measurement of promotion-driven CR (Conversion Rate) uplift.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud Promotions Engine

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: High-level channel classification of how the visitor arrived at the digital storefront. Supports digital marketing attribution, CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis, and channel-level CR (Conversion Rate) reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_search|paid_search|social|email|direct|affiliate|display|referral|sms|push_notification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: referral_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the referring page or external site that directed the visitor to the digital storefront. Null for direct traffic. Enables granular attribution analysis beyond high-level referral_source classification.

attributes.name: search_query_count
attributes.description: Number of on-site search queries executed by the visitor during the session. Indicator of product discovery intent and search effectiveness. Used to optimize PIM (Product Information Management) and assortment depth.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds between session_start_timestamp and session_end_timestamp. Raw measurement used to compute average session duration KPIs and correlate engagement with CR (Conversion Rate) and AOV (Average Order Value).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the visitor session ended, either through explicit logout, timeout, or browser close. Null if session is still active. Used to compute session duration.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the visitor session was initiated on the digital storefront. Principal business event timestamp for session lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the web session. 'active' = session in progress; 'completed' = session ended with a conversion event; 'abandoned' = session ended without conversion; 'timed_out' = session expired due to inactivity; 'bounced' = single-page session with immediate exit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Session Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: session_token
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric session identifier generated by the e-commerce platform (SFCC) at session initiation. Used for cross-system session correlation and digital journey stitching across touchpoints.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this web session record was last modified in the Silver Layer, such as when session_end_timestamp or conversion flags are updated upon session close.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter identifying the specific marketing campaign name or promotion (e.g., spring_sale_2024, loyalty_reactivation). Links sessions to Pricing and Promotions Management campaigns.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) content parameter used to differentiate ads or links pointing to the same URL (e.g., banner_top, text_link). Supports A/B testing and creative-level CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) medium parameter identifying the marketing medium (e.g., cpc, email, social, banner). Used alongside utm_source for multi-channel attribution and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) contribution analysis.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) source parameter from the session entry URL, identifying the advertiser, site, publication, or other source (e.g., google, newsletter, facebook). Core dimension for digital marketing campaign attribution.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) term parameter capturing the paid search keyword that triggered the session. Used for paid search keyword-level ROI (Return on Investment) and CTR (Click-Through Rate) analysis.

attributes.name: visitor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visitor for this session. 'new' = first-time visitor; 'returning' = previously visited but not authenticated; 'authenticated' = logged-in registered customer; 'guest' = checkout without account. Supports CR (Conversion Rate) segmentation and personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Visitor Segmentation; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

products.name: cart
products.description: Represents a shopping cart instance created during a customer's digital session on a storefront. Captures cart creation timestamp, last modified timestamp, cart status (active, abandoned, converted, expired), total item count, subtotal, applied promotion/coupon identifiers, discount amounts, estimated tax, estimated shipping, and the channel/storefront context. Includes digital promotion redemption details: promotion ID, coupon code, discount amount, redemption channel (web, mobile app, email link), redemption status (applied, validated, rejected, reversed), and customer identity reference. SSOT for cart-level data supporting abandoned cart recovery, AOV analysis, and promotion effectiveness measurement within the digital channel. Cart abandonment is determined by timeout or session expiry; recovery workflows are tracked in the abandoned_cart_recovery product.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a shopping cart instance created during a customer's digital session on a storefront. Serves as the primary key for the cart data product and is referenced by cart line items, abandoned cart recovery workflows, and order conversion records.

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.coupon. Business justification: Coupon validation and redemption tracking at cart level: when a customer applies a coupon code in their online cart, the system must reference the coupon master record for eligibility validation, rede

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location selected by the customer for Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) or Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) fulfillment. Null for ship-to-home and drop-ship carts. Supports online-to-offline attribution, store-level BOPIS volume reporting, and inventory reservation at the designated store.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud BOPIS Configuration; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who owns this cart. Null for guest/anonymous sessions where no login has occurred. Used for abandoned cart recovery, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) attribution, and personalization workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Customer Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary promotion applied to this cart. Used for promotion effectiveness measurement, discount attribution, and digital marketing ROI analysis. A cart may have one primary promotion; additional promotions are tracked at the line level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud Promotions

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
