attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Body Field; FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: review_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the review text, e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es-MX'. Supports multi-locale storefront display, NLP model routing, and translation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 — Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Locale Configuration

attributes.name: review_title
attributes.description: Short headline or subject line of the review as entered by the customer. Used for display on the product detail page (PDP) and for text analytics and sentiment classification.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Title Field

attributes.name: reviewer_display_name
attributes.description: Pseudonymous or chosen display name shown publicly alongside the review on the storefront. May be a username alias rather than a legal name. Classified as confidential PII as it can be linked back to a customer identity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Reviewer Nickname Field

attributes.name: reviewer_expertise_level
attributes.description: Categorical tier assigned to the reviewer based on their review history, helpfulness votes, and engagement on the platform. Used to weight review credibility in product quality scoring and to surface expert reviews prominently on the PDP.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Reviewer Reputation System; NRF — Customer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: reviewer_location_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the self-reported or inferred country of the reviewer. Used for geo-segmented product quality analysis and regulatory compliance (GDPR for EU reviewers, CCPA for California residents).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: sentiment_label
attributes.description: Categorical sentiment classification derived from the sentiment_score: 'positive', 'neutral', or 'negative'. Provides a human-readable bucketing of the ML score for reporting dashboards and product quality KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — AI-Powered Review Analytics; NRF — Customer Experience Analytics

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Machine-learning-derived sentiment polarity score for the review body text, ranging from -1.0000 (most negative) to 1.0000 (most positive). Computed by the NLP enrichment pipeline and stored as a Silver Layer attribute for downstream analytics and AI/ML model features.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — AI-Powered Review Analytics; NRF — Customer Experience Analytics

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: Numeric star rating submitted by the reviewer on a 1-to-5 scale, where 1 is the lowest satisfaction and 5 is the highest. Core quantitative signal for product quality scoring, NPS-adjacent sentiment tracking, and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) — Customer Experience Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Rating Field

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer submitted the review on the digital storefront. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the review was created by the reviewer. Used for recency ranking and post-purchase review solicitation SLA measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Created Date; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: syndication_partner_review_reference
attributes.description: The unique review identifier assigned by the third-party syndication partner (e.g., Bazaarvoice, PowerReviews). Populated only when syndication_source is not 'native'. Enables reconciliation with partner platforms.

attributes.name: syndication_source
attributes.description: Identifies the platform or syndication network from which the review originated. 'native' = submitted directly on the retailer's own storefront; other values indicate third-party review syndication partners. Drives deduplication and source attribution logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Source Field; GS1 — Product Data Syndication Standards

attributes.name: unhelpful_vote_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of 'not helpful' votes cast by other shoppers on this review. Used alongside helpful_vote_count to compute net helpfulness score and filter low-quality reviews from prominent display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Helpfulness Voting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the product_review record was last modified in the Silver Layer, including moderation status changes, vote count updates, or syndication enrichments. Supports incremental processing and change data capture.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

products.name: marketplace_listing
products.description: Master record for Retail's product listings on third-party marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Google Shopping), capturing the marketplace platform, marketplace-specific identifier (ASIN, eBay item ID, Walmart item ID), mapped internal SKU/UPC, listing title, listing status (active, suppressed, inactive, out-of-stock), buy-box ownership flag, marketplace price, marketplace fulfillment method (FBM, FBA, WFS), listing quality score, content compliance flags, and last sync timestamp. Supports marketplace channel management, competitive pricing intelligence, and GMV tracking across third-party channels.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each marketplace listing record in the Retail data platform. Primary key for the marketplace_listing product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Master Data Management golden record identifier

Buyers track assortment item performance across owned and marketplace channels, reconcile OTB budget consum

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Marketplace orders fulfilled from stores require tracking which store ships the item. Real business process: marketplace ship-from-store operations, store-level marketplace performance reporting, inve

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_node. Retailers track fulfillment node assignments per listing for 3P order routing, invento

attributes.name: marketplace_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Marketplace listings organized by retail category hierarchy for performance reporting, competitive analysis, and assortment planning. Category-level marketplace strategy (pricing, promotion, inventory

attributes.name: marketplace_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that this marketplace listing represents. Links the marketplace listing to Retail's internal product master record managed in the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) and the customer master data system.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 product identification standards

attributes.name: marketplace_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Marketplace drop-ship and third-party seller models require tracking which vendor fulfills each listing. Business processes: drop-ship order routing to correct vendor, vendor performance scorecarding

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Marketplace pricing teams need to know which price_list policy governs each listing for channel compliance, MAP enforcement, and competitive pricing audits. marketplace_listing has sku_price_id but no

attributes.description: add column pricing_sku_price_id (BIGINT) with FK to pricing.sku_price.sku_price_id - marketplace listings need explicit price references for price parity management

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Marketplace campaign activation: retailers run promotional campaigns specifically on marketplace platforms (Prime Day, platform deal events, sponsored campaign windows). Linking marketplace_listing to

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Marketplace promotional pricing: retailers apply specific promo offers to marketplace listings (platform deal events, buy-box promotional pricing). Linking to promo_offer enables offer eligibility man

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Marketplace listings are often seasonal merchandise. Buyers manage marketplace assortment by season, track seasonal sell-through on external channels, plan seasonal markdown and exit strategies, and r

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: add column storefront_id (BIGINT) with FK to ecommerce.storefront.storefront_id - marketplace listings are published through specific storefronts

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Marketplace listings must reference the specific vendor item record for cost basis, pack configuration, GTIN, and compliance attributes. This link enables marketplace content syndication accuracy, cos

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product listing has an age restriction (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, adult content, rated video games). True = age-gated product; False = no age restriction. Drives marketplace compliance controls and checkout age verification flows.
attributes.references: FTC regulations on age-restricted products; FDA tobacco and alcohol labeling; CPSC age-graded toy safety standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name associated with the marketplace listing. Used for brand registry enforcement, private label identification, and marketplace brand analytics. Sourced from the customer master data system product golden record.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM product master; GS1 brand identification standards; Amazon Brand Registry

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: The full hierarchical category path assigned to this listing on the marketplace (e.g., 'Electronics > Computers > Laptops'). Used for category management, assortment breadth analysis, and marketplace taxonomy alignment. May differ from internal the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS) category hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) category hierarchy; GS1 product classification (GPC); NRF category management standards

attributes.name: content_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing content meets all applicable marketplace content policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA labeling for food/grocery, CPSC safety warnings, FTC advertising standards). True = compliant; False = compliance issue detected requiring remediation.
attributes.references: FDA food labeling requirements (21 CFR Part 101); CPSC product safety labeling; FTC advertising standards; Amazon Seller Central content policy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the marketplace locale where this listing is published (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, DEU). Supports international marketplace operations, cross-border compliance, and regional GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes; GDPR cross-border data requirements; FTC international commerce standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this marketplace_listing record was first created in the Retail data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from listed_timestamp which reflects the marketplace publication date. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer audit standards; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the marketplace_price (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency marketplace operations and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency codes; FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: The 13-digit European Article Number (EAN) / GTIN-13 for the listed product. Required for international marketplace listings (e.g., eBay international, Google Shopping). Sourced from the customer master data system product golden record.
attributes.references: GS1 EAN-13 / GTIN-13 international barcode standard

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: The fulfillment method used for this marketplace listing. FBM = Fulfilled by Merchant (Retail ships directly); FBA = Fulfilled by Amazon (Amazon warehouses and ships); WFS = Walmart Fulfillment Services; SFS = Ship-from-Store; Dropship = vendor direct-to-customer; 3PL = Third-Party Logistics provider. Drives operational routing in Manhattan Associates WMS and Blue Yonder Demand Planning.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central FBA/FBM definitions; Walmart Marketplace WFS program; NRF omnichannel fulfillment standards

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listed product is classified as hazardous material, requiring special handling, packaging, or shipping restrictions on the marketplace. True = hazmat product; False = standard product. Impacts FBA/WFS eligibility and shipping method selection.
attributes.references: CPSC hazardous material product safety standards; DOT hazmat shipping regulations; Amazon FBA hazmat review process

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: The total number of product images published on this marketplace listing. Contributes to listing_quality_score; marketplaces typically reward listings with multiple high-quality images with improved search placement.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central listing quality guidelines; Walmart Marketplace content score methodology

attributes.name: inventory_quantity
attributes.description: The current available inventory quantity published to the marketplace for this listing. Drives out-of-stock status and buy box eligibility. Synchronized from Manhattan Associates WMS or Blue Yonder Demand Planning replenishment signals.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS inventory management; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF inventory management standards

attributes.name: is_buy_box_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether Retail currently owns the buy box (featured offer) for this marketplace listing. True = Retail is the featured seller; False = a competing seller holds the buy box. Critical KPI for marketplace channel management and competitive pricing strategy. Sourced from marketplace API sync.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central Buy Box eligibility criteria; Walmart Marketplace featured merchant program

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing is for a private label (store brand) product owned by Retail. True = private label / own-brand product; False = national or third-party brand. Private label listings typically have exclusive buy box ownership and different margin profiles.
attributes.references: NRF private label product standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) brand classification

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization between Retail's internal systems (the e-commerce platform / the customer master data system) and the marketplace platform API. Used to detect stale listings and trigger re-sync workflows. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud marketplace connector; Informatica MDM synchronization audit; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: listed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this listing was first published or activated on the marketplace platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED equivalent for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Used for listing age analysis and new product launch tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud listing management; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: listing_quality_score
attributes.description: Marketplace-assigned or internally calculated score (0–100) reflecting the completeness and quality of the listing content (title, images, bullet points, description, A+ content). Higher scores correlate with improved search ranking and conversion rate (CR). Sourced from marketplace API or internal PIM (Product Information Management) audit.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central Listing Quality dashboard; Walmart Marketplace Content Score; NRF product content standards

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the marketplace listing. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. 'active' = live and buyable; 'suppressed' = marketplace has hidden the listing due to content/compliance issues; 'inactive' = manually deactivated; 'out_of_stock' = no inventory available; 'pending_review' = awaiting marketplace approval; 'removed' = permanently delisted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suppressed|inactive|out_of_stock|pending_review|removed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central listing status definitions; Walmart Marketplace Seller Help; NRF omnichannel standards

attributes.name: listing_title
attributes.description: The product title as displayed on the marketplace listing page. This is the IDENTITY_LABEL for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Optimized per marketplace SEO and content guidelines; may differ from the internal product name in the PIM (Product Information Management) system.
attributes.references: GS1 product content standards; Amazon Seller Central listing guidelines; Walmart Marketplace content policy

attributes.name: listing_url
attributes.description: The direct URL to the product listing page on the marketplace. Used for competitive monitoring, digital marketing attribution, and customer service reference. Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital commerce URL management; NRF e-commerce standards

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 locale code for the marketplace listing (e.g., en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE). Determines language, currency formatting, and regulatory content requirements for the listing. Supports localization compliance for international marketplace operations.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 language tag standard; GDPR localization requirements; Amazon Seller Central marketplace locale definitions

attributes.name: main_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the primary product image displayed on the marketplace listing. Image quality and compliance with marketplace image standards directly impacts listing_quality_score and conversion rate (CR). Managed via PIM (Product Information Management) system.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central image requirements; Walmart Marketplace image standards; GS1 product image guidelines

attributes.name: marketplace_item_code
attributes.description: The platform-native unique identifier assigned by the marketplace to this listing (e.g., Amazon ASIN, eBay Item ID, Walmart Item ID). Used for API synchronization, competitive pricing intelligence, and marketplace-specific operations. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: GS1 global product identification standards; Amazon Seller Central ASIN specification; Walmart Marketplace API

attributes.name: marketplace_platform
attributes.description: The third-party marketplace platform on which this listing is published (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Google Shopping). Drives channel-specific GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting and marketplace channel management strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: amazon|ebay|walmart_marketplace|google_shopping|target_plus|other — promote to reference product if additional platforms are onboarded]
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) omnichannel commerce standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud channel taxonomy

attributes.name: marketplace_price
attributes.description: The current selling price of the product on the marketplace listing, expressed in the listing currency. MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Used for competitive pricing intelligence, AUR (Average Unit Retail) tracking, and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) calculation. Managed via the retail merchandising system Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC pricing transparency regulations; FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition

attributes.name: marketplace_rating
attributes.description: The average customer star rating for this listing on the marketplace (typically 1.0–5.0 scale). Influences buy box eligibility, search ranking, and conversion rate (CR). Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central product rating; Walmart Marketplace seller performance metrics; NRF customer experience standards

attributes.name: marketplace_seller_code
attributes.description: Retail's seller account identifier on the marketplace platform (e.g., Amazon Merchant ID, Walmart Seller ID). Used to distinguish Retail's listings from third-party sellers on the same marketplace and to attribute GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) to the correct seller account.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central merchant account; Walmart Marketplace seller account management

attributes.name: marketplace_storefront_name
attributes.description: The display name of Retail's storefront or seller profile on the marketplace (e.g., 'Retail Official Store' on Amazon). Used for brand consistency monitoring and customer-facing identity management across marketplace channels.
attributes.references: Amazon Brand Store guidelines; Walmart Marketplace storefront policy; NRF omnichannel brand standards

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP) or list price for the product. Used as the reference price for markdown calculations and marketplace price compliance. Sourced from the retail merchandising system Merchandising System (ORMS).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); FTC pricing transparency and deceptive pricing regulations

attributes.name: prime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing qualifies for marketplace premium fast-shipping programs (e.g., Amazon Prime, Walmart TwoDay). True = eligible for fast-shipping badge; False = standard shipping only. Directly impacts buy box eligibility and conversion rate (CR).
attributes.references: Amazon Prime eligibility requirements; Walmart TwoDay delivery program; NRF last-mile delivery standards

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum inventory quantity level at which a replenishment order is triggered for this marketplace listing. Used in conjunction with Blue Yonder Demand Planning to prevent out-of-stock events and maintain listing availability.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning replenishment rules; Manhattan Associates WMS reorder point logic

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: The total number of customer reviews submitted for this listing on the marketplace. Used alongside marketplace_rating to assess listing credibility and conversion rate (CR) performance. Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central review metrics; Walmart Marketplace seller performance dashboard; FTC guidelines on consumer reviews

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of units sold to units available for this listing over a rolling period (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.75 = 75% sell-through rate). Used for inventory health monitoring, markdown decision support, and dead stock identification. Calculated from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) POS/digital transaction data.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF inventory management KPIs; Blue Yonder Demand Planning sell-through analytics

attributes.name: shipping_weight_kg
attributes.description: The shipping weight of the product in kilograms as declared on the marketplace listing. Used for marketplace fulfillment fee calculation (FBA, WFS), shipping cost estimation, and hazmat classification. Sourced from the customer master data system product master.
attributes.references: GS1 product measurement standards; Amazon FBA weight-based fee schedule; Walmart WFS dimensional weight policy

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description provided by the marketplace when a listing is suppressed or removed (e.g., 'missing_main_image', 'price_violation', 'restricted_product', 'safety_recall'). Populated only when listing_status = 'suppressed' or 'removed'. Used for remediation workflow management.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central suppression reason codes; Walmart Marketplace listing policy violations; CPSC product recall notifications

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) associated with this listing. Used by marketplaces for product catalog matching and compliance. Sourced from the customer master data system product golden record.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC-A barcode standard; CPSC product identification requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this marketplace listing record in the Retail data platform (Silver Layer). Tracks content changes, price updates, status transitions, and inventory adjustments. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer audit standards; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

products.name: storefront_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the localized assortment execution strategy between assortment_plan and storefront. It captures how a single merchandising assortment plan is adapted and deployed across different digital storefronts with locale-specific SKU selections, timing, and depth targets. Each record links one assortment_plan to one storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this channel-specific execution.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, a single merchandising assortment plan (e.g., Spring Apparel 2024) is executed differently across multiple digital storefronts based on locale, market maturity, currency, and channel strategy. Conversely, a single storefront carries multiple assortment plans simultaneously across different categories, seasons, and departments. The business actively manages these storefront-specific assortment configurations as operational records with localized SKU selections, launch timing, budget allocations, and publication workflows.

attributes.name: storefront_assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this storefront-specific assortment execution record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the source assortment plan being executed on this storefront

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (merchandiser or e-commerce manager) who published this assortment configuration to the storefront.

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for carrier and 3PL partners used for outbound shipment execution, encompassing carrier identity, service catalog, and contracted rate cards. Captures carrier name, carrier code, carrier type (parcel, LTL, FTL, last-mile, same-day), SCAC code, EDI/API integration capabilities. Service catalog includes service levels (ground, 2-day, overnight, same-day, BOPIS-ready), transit days by zone, cutoff times, max weight/dimensions, surcharge types, tracking capability, signature required flag, and geographic restrictions. Rate card includes base rates by zone/weight/service, dimensional weight factor, fuel surcharges, residential delivery surcharges, extended area surcharges, negotiated discount percentages, rate effective and expiry dates, and weight breaks. Serves as the single source of truth for all carrier master data, service definitions, and freight cost references within the fulfillment domain. Used in carrier selection logic during fulfillment order routing and freight cost estimation.

products.name: node_carrier_service
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of carrier services to fulfillment nodes. It captures which carrier services are available at each fulfillment node, their priority in carrier selection algorithms, node-specific cutoff times, and capacity constraints. Each record links one carrier service to one fulfillment node with attributes that exist only in the context of this node-specific carrier configuration.. Existence Justification: In retail fulfillment operations, carrier service availability is explicitly configured per fulfillment node by operations managers. A single carrier service (e.g., FedEx Ground) serves hundreds of fulfillment nodes across the network, and each fulfillment node uses multiple carrier services (typically 3-8) with node-specific priority rankings, cutoff times, and daily volume caps. This is an operational business process called 'node carrier configuration' or 'carrier service assignment' that fulfillment teams actively manage.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.cancellation. Business justification: Order cancellations trigger refunds; the refund must reference the cancellation for audit trail completeness, finance reconciliation, and regulatory compliance. Retail operations distinguish cancellat

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Refund processing costs (labor, payment processing fees, fraud review) are allocated to cost centers for departmental P&L and budget variance analysis. Essential for retail operations financial manage

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order that is being refunded. Enables traceability to the original purchase transaction.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where the refund was processed, if applicable. Used for store-level financial reconciliation and performance analysis.

attributes.name: original_discount_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.discount. Business justification: Refund amount calculation for discounted items requires referencing the original discount to determine the correct refundable amount. Retail finance teams use this link for promotional liability repor

attributes.name: original_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.payment. Business justification: Refunds must be processed back to the original payment instrument (masked PAN, digital wallet, BNPL provider). Payment processor refund routing, PCI compliance reporting, and fraud detection all requi

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.pos_terminal. Business justification: In-store refunds are processed through a specific POS terminal. PCI-DSS compliance and fraud audit requirements mandate that refund transactions be traceable to the terminal that processed them. refun

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: In-store refunds are executed within a POS transaction. End-of-day tender reconciliation, cash drawer balancing, and store-level refund reporting require linking the refund record to the POS transacti

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer receiving the refund. Links refund to customer master data for reconciliation and customer lifetime value analysis.

attributes.name: promo_redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_redemption. Business justification: Refund processing must reference original promotional redemption to calculate correct refund amount (excluding promotional discount), update vendor funding obligations, and enforce promotional terms.

attributes.name: return_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.return_receipt. Business justification: Refunds are frequently triggered by the return_receipt event (return_receipt.refund_triggered_flag = true). Adding return_receipt_id to refund creates a direct financial-to-physical traceability link,

attributes.name: return_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent return transaction that triggered this refund. Links refund to the originating return merchandise authorization (RMA).

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: FK to returns.rma.rma_id — Refund to RMA linkage is required for return financial reconciliation — every refund must trace back to its authorizing RMA for audit and financial controls.

attributes.name: actual_settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the refund funds were confirmed as settled and available to the customer. Used for SLA compliance measurement and financial reconciliation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional positive or negative adjustment applied to the refund for reasons such as damage, missing components, promotional credits, or goodwill gestures.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by authorized personnel or automated business rules. Represents authorization milestone in the refund workflow. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Unique authorization or approval code issued by the payment processor confirming the refund transaction was approved. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The customer-facing channel or touchpoint through which the refund was initiated and processed. Enables omnichannel analytics and channel performance measurement.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was successfully completed and funds were transferred to the customer. Represents final settlement of the refund transaction. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this refund record was first created in the database. Used for data lineage and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this refund transaction. Ensures proper financial reconciliation in multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: expected_settlement_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the refund funds will be available to the customer in their account. Used for customer communication and service level agreement (SLA) tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0 to 100. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk. Used for risk-based decisioning.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund transaction was first created or initiated in the system. Marks the beginning of the refund lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: is_fraudulent
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the refund was identified as fraudulent or suspicious. Used for fraud analytics and loss prevention reporting.

attributes.name: merchandise_amount
attributes.description: The gross value of returned merchandise being refunded, before any fees, taxes, or adjustments. Represents the base product value from the original transaction.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to issue the refund to the customer. Determines processing workflow and reconciliation requirements.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by customer service representatives or system users providing additional context about the refund transaction.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or financial institution processing the refund transaction. Used for reconciliation and troubleshooting payment failures.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was submitted to the payment processor for execution. Indicates when the financial transaction was initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: processor_response_code
attributes.description: Standardized response code returned by the payment processor indicating success, failure, or specific error condition. Used for operational monitoring and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: processor_response_message
attributes.description: Human-readable message from the payment processor providing additional context about the transaction result. Used for customer service and technical support.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for issuing the refund. Used for root cause analysis, quality management, and vendor chargeback processing. Format: AAA999.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the refund was issued. Provides context beyond the standardized reason code for customer service and quality analysis.

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the refund transaction. Used for customer communication, customer service lookup, and external reporting. Format: RFN-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction. Tracks progression from initiation through final settlement or failure. Used for operational monitoring and customer service inquiries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|processing|completed|failed|reversed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund based on the portion of the original transaction being refunded and any adjustments applied.

attributes.name: restocking_fee
attributes.description: Fee deducted from the refund amount to cover costs of processing, inspecting, and restocking returned merchandise. Applied per return policy terms.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: The shipping or delivery fee amount being refunded, if applicable per return policy. May be zero if shipping is non-refundable.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The sales tax or value-added tax (VAT) amount being refunded to the customer. Must align with original tax calculation and jurisdiction requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: total_refund_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount refunded to the customer after all fees, taxes, and adjustments. This is the actual monetary value transferred back to the customer.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction identifier or reference number from the payment processor. Links internal refund record to external payment system for reconciliation.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this refund record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: exchange_order
products.description: Exchange order created when a return is resolved via product replacement rather than monetary refund. Captures the originating RMA reference, replacement SKU(s) and quantities, price differential (upgrade or downgrade), exchange order status, fulfillment channel (ship-to-home, in-store pickup, curbside), and the linked replacement order identifier. Enables tracking of exchange fulfillment as a distinct resolution path separate from standard order flow.

attributes.name: exchange_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exchange order. Primary key.

attributes.name: exchange_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where the exchange was initiated or will be fulfilled, if applicable.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, store, or fulfillment location from which the replacement item will be shipped.

attributes.name: primary_exchange_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original order from which the returned item originated.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who initiated the exchange.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Exchange orders during active promotions require offer attribution to correctly compute price differentials and determine whether the replacement item qualifies for the same promotional pricing. Retai

attributes.name: replacement_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Exchange fulfillment requires direct replacement SKU reference for inventory allocation, ATP (available-to-promise) checking, and like-for-like exchange policy enforcement. Essential for retail exchan

attributes.name: replacement_sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Exchange order price differential calculation requires the replacement SKU's current retail price from sku_price. price_differential_amount is computed as replacement price minus returned item price.

attributes.name: replacement_stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Exchange fulfillment inventory allocation: when an exchange order is created, the replacement SKU must be sourced from a specific stock position. Links exchange order to the inventory position being d

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating RMA that triggered this exchange order.

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Exchange orders require a shipping address for replacement item delivery. Fulfillment operations depend on this link to route exchange shipments correctly. While exchange_order.profile_id provides ind

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exchange order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: exchange_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exchange request was approved by the returns management system or customer service representative.

attributes.name: exchange_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the entire exchange transaction was finalized, including receipt of returned item and delivery of replacement.

attributes.name: exchange_delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replacement item was successfully delivered to the customer.

attributes.name: exchange_initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer first requested the exchange, typically when the RMA was created.

attributes.name: exchange_order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the exchange order, used for customer communication and tracking.

attributes.name: exchange_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exchange order in the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|processing|shipped|delivered|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exchange_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason the customer requested an exchange rather than a refund.

attributes.name: exchange_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about why the customer requested an exchange.

attributes.name: exchange_shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replacement item was shipped to the customer.

attributes.name: exchange_source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer initiated the exchange request.

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange based on the relationship between returned and replacement items.

attributes.name: expedited_shipping_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expedited shipping was used for the replacement item delivery.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: Method by which the replacement item will be delivered to the customer.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exchange order record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: price_differential_amount
attributes.description: Net price difference between the replacement and returned items. Positive indicates customer owes additional payment (upgrade), negative indicates refund due (downgrade).

attributes.name: price_differential_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the price differential amount.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount to be refunded to the customer if the replacement item costs less than the returned item (downgrade scenario).

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which any refund amount will be returned to the customer.

attributes.name: replacement_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the replacement SKU being sent to the customer.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the returned SKU being sent back by the customer.

attributes.name: returned_sku
attributes.description: SKU of the product being returned by the customer as part of the exchange.

attributes.name: shipping_cost_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipping costs for the replacement item have been waived as a customer service gesture.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special handling instructions or notes related to the exchange order.

products.name: return_policy
products.description: Master record defining return policy rules by merchandise category, sales channel, and customer segment. Captures return window duration, restocking fee rules, accepted return conditions, proof-of-purchase requirements, non-returnable item exceptions, channel applicability (in-store, online, BOPIS), loyalty tier overrides (extended windows for premium members), SLA processing targets by return stage, and policy effective/expiry dates. Drives automated RMA authorization logic and operational SLA measurement.

attributes.name: return_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the return policy record. Primary key.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.format. Business justification: Retail return policies are scoped by store format — hypermarkets have different return windows and restocking fees than discount outlets. Format-level policy assignment drives POS return policy lookup

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Return policies vary by merchandise category (electronics 30-day vs apparel 90-day vs grocery no-return). Essential for POS policy enforcement, return window calculation, restocking fee application, a

attributes.name: merchandising_category_id
attributes.description: add column merchandising_category_id (BIGINT) with FK to merchandising.category.category_id - return policies vary by merchandise category (electronics vs. apparel) and need this linkage beyond just item_hierarchy

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Consumer protection laws and return window regulations vary by region/jurisdiction. Retail compliance teams assign region-specific return policies to meet local regulatory requirements (e.g., EU consu

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Return policies vary by season (extended holiday windows, clearance restrictions). Retail operations require season-specific policy rules for merchandise purchased during peak/clearance periods to man

attributes.name: accepted_condition
attributes.description: Required condition of merchandise for return acceptance. Defines whether items must be unopened, unused, or can be returned in any condition.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether returns under this policy require manager or supervisor approval before processing. Common for high-value items or out-of-window returns.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this return policy record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return policy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and policy lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment or loyalty tier to which this return policy applies. Premium members may receive extended return windows.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this return policy expires and is no longer applicable to new transactions. Nullable for open-ended policies.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this return policy becomes active and applicable to transactions. Policies are not enforced before this date.

attributes.name: exchange_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct product exchanges (size, color, model) are permitted under this policy without requiring a full return and repurchase.

attributes.name: extended_window_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended Return Window Duration in Days
attributes.description: Extended return window duration for premium loyalty tier members or special promotional periods. Nullable if no extension applies.

tag_set.value: Extended Return Window Duration in Days

attributes.name: holiday_extension_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes extended return windows for holiday season purchases (e.g., purchases made in November-December returnable through mid-January).

attributes.name: inspection_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return Inspection Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours for completing merchandise inspection and condition assessment after return receipt. Used for operational SLA measurement.

tag_set.value: Return Inspection Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this return policy record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return policy record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: liquidation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether returned merchandise under this policy can be sent to liquidation channels (discount outlets, bulk resellers) for recovery.

attributes.name: non_returnable_item_exceptions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of item types or SKU patterns that are explicitly excluded from returns under this policy (e.g., perishables, intimate apparel, custom orders, clearance items).

attributes.name: original_packaging_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item must be returned in its original packaging for acceptance. Common for electronics and high-value items.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the return policy, used in operational systems and customer communications. Unique alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the return policy terms and conditions, including any special provisions, exclusions, or customer-facing language.

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the return policy (e.g., 'Standard 30-Day Return', 'Electronics Extended Return', 'Final Sale No Return').

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the return policy indicating the policy category and applicability scope.

attributes.name: policy_url
attributes.description: Web URL where the full return policy terms are published for customer reference. Required for e-commerce compliance.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level for processing returns under this policy. Premium and VIP customers may receive expedited processing.

attributes.name: proof_of_purchase_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether proof of purchase (receipt, order confirmation, transaction lookup) is mandatory for return processing.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which refunds are issued under this policy. May restrict refunds to store credit or exchange for certain categories or conditions.

attributes.name: refund_processing_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Refund Processing Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours for completing refund processing from return acceptance to funds disbursement. Used for operational SLA measurement.

tag_set.value: Refund Processing Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours

attributes.name: restocking_fee_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a restocking fee is charged for returns under this policy. Common for high-value electronics and special-order items.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_flat_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged as a restocking fee, regardless of purchase price. Nullable if percentage-based or no fee applies.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the original purchase price charged as a restocking fee. Nullable if no restocking fee applies. Typical range is 10-25%.

attributes.name: restocking_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restocking Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours for restocking accepted returned merchandise back into available inventory. Used for operational SLA measurement.

tag_set.value: Restocking Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Hours

attributes.name: return_policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return policy. Only active policies are applied to new transactions.

attributes.name: return_shipping_paid_by
attributes.description: Party responsible for paying return shipping costs. Retailer-paid shipping is common for defective items or retailer errors; customer-paid for buyer remorse.

attributes.name: return_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase date during which a return is accepted under this policy. Standard retail windows range from 14 to 90 days.

attributes.name: rma_auto_approval_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Auto-Approval Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RMA requests are automatically approved based on policy rules without manual review. Drives automated return authorization logic.

tag_set.value: Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Auto-Approval Enabled Flag

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel(s) to which this return policy applies. Policies may vary by channel (e.g., online purchases may have different return windows than in-store). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_store|online|mobile_app|bopis|ropis|call_center|all_channels — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: store_credit_expiry_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Store Credit Expiry Duration in Days
attributes.description: Number of days until store credit issued for returns expires. Nullable if store credit does not expire. Subject to state-specific gift card laws.

tag_set.value: Store Credit Expiry Duration in Days

attributes.name: vendor_return_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether merchandise returned under this policy is eligible for Return to Vendor (RTV) processing to recover costs from suppliers.

products.name: store_credit
products.description: Store credit instrument issued as return resolution in lieu of cash or card refund. Functions as a stored-value financial instrument with its own lifecycle: issuance, partial redemption, full redemption, expiration, or voiding. Captures credit code, issued and remaining balance, issue/expiry dates, issuing channel and location, customer and originating RMA references. Integrates with POS and e-commerce systems for omnichannel redemption.

attributes.name: store_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store credit instrument. Primary key.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original order that was returned and resulted in this store credit issuance. Provides full traceability from purchase through return to credit.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer to whom this store credit was issued. Enables customer-level credit balance tracking and redemption history.

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating RMA that triggered this store credit issuance. Links the credit back to the return transaction.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the store credit was issued. Null for credits issued through digital channels.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Machine-readable barcode representation of the store credit code for POS scanning. Supports omnichannel redemption workflows.

attributes.name: breakage_estimate_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a breakage revenue estimate (expected non-redemption) has been applied to this store credit for financial reporting purposes under ASC 606.

attributes.name: combinable_with_promotions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store credit can be combined with other promotional discounts during redemption. Supports pricing and promotion policy enforcement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the store credit record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_code
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique alphanumeric code printed on the store credit instrument or provided digitally. Used for redemption at POS or e-commerce checkout.

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason or business context for issuing this store credit. Distinguishes between return-driven credits, promotional incentives, and service recovery gestures.
attributes.references: Internal Returns and Customer Service Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the store credit monetary values. Supports multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: escheatment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the unredeemed balance must be reported and remitted to the state as unclaimed property. Null if not subject to escheatment.

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the unredeemed balance is subject to state escheatment (unclaimed property) laws. Supports regulatory compliance for abandoned store credits.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the store credit expires and can no longer be redeemed. Nullable for credits with no expiration policy.
attributes.references: State Gift Card and Store Credit Regulations

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the store credit was issued to the customer. Marks the start of the credit's validity period.

attributes.name: issued_amount
attributes.description: Original monetary value of the store credit at the time of issuance. Represents the full stored-value balance before any redemptions.

attributes.name: issuing_channel
attributes.description: The customer-facing channel through which the store credit was issued. Supports omnichannel returns and credit issuance analytics.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the store credit record was most recently updated. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent partial or full redemption transaction. Null if the credit has never been redeemed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or customer service notes related to the store credit issuance or redemption.

attributes.name: pin_code
attributes.description: Optional security PIN required for redemption of the store credit. Protects against unauthorized use if the credit code is compromised.

attributes.name: redemption_channel_restriction
attributes.description: Policy constraint on where the store credit can be redeemed. Supports business rules for channel-specific credits.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed monetary value available on the store credit. Decreases with each partial redemption until fully redeemed or expired.

attributes.name: store_credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the store credit. Tracks progression from issuance through redemption, expiration, or voiding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|active|partially_redeemed|fully_redeemed|expired|voided|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store credit can be transferred or gifted to another customer. False means the credit is locked to the original recipient.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the store credit was voided. Null if the credit has not been voided.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls and Audit Standard

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason the store credit was voided. Null if the credit has not been voided.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls and Audit Standard

domains.name: supplychain
domains.description: Manages end-to-end supply chain planning and execution from demand forecasting through distribution center operations, including facility management, warehouse workflows, inbound/outbound logistics, replenishment planning, purchase order lifecycle, cross-docking, and supply chain performance monitoring.

products.name: replenishment_plan
products.description: Replenishment plans for SKUs across all supply chain nodes (stores, DCs, MFCs), generated by Blue Yonder or equivalent planning engine. Captures planned order quantities, replenishment triggers, reorder points, safety stock levels and policy parameters (calculation method, service level target, demand variability factor), weeks-of-supply targets, plan status, and MOQ enforcement rules (minimum order quantity, order multiples, minimum order value). SSOT for automated replenishment decisions including buffer stock governance and supplier ordering constraints.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each replenishment plan record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the replenishment_plan data product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: replenishment_plan.unit_cost is a denormalized copy of the cost_price master. Linking to cost_price enables planned_order_value accuracy using authoritative landed cost and supports retail open-to-buy

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast plan from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drove the generation of this replenishment plan. Enables traceability from replenishment decision back to the underlying demand signal.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Plan Reference

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.associate. Business justification: Replenishment planners own plans for planning accountability and forecast accuracy tracking. Supply chain tracks planner performance on service levels, inventory turns, and forecast bias for performan

attributes.name: plan_item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: item_hierarchy carries replenishment_method, safety_stock_weeks, and lead_time_days — the source parameters for replenishment planning. Linking replenishment_plan to item_hierarchy allows category man

attributes.name: replenishment_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) for which this replenishment plan is generated. Identifies the destination receiving location in the replenishment network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Network Node; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: replenishment_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this replenishment plan is generated. The SKU is the primary product-level identifier used in replenishment planning across stores, DCs, and MFCs.
attributes.references: GS1 - Global Product Identification Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: replenishment_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling this replenishment plan. Links to the supplier master for MOQ enforcement, lead time, and EDI ordering constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Replenishment planning uses current retail price to compute planned_order_value and evaluate margin thresholds before releasing orders. Retail planners must reference the active sku_price to validate

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Replenishment planning requires vendor_item specs (unit_cost, moq, pack_size, inner_pack_quantity) to calculate planned_order_value and validate moq_compliance_flag. Supply planners expect replenishme

attributes.name: approved_order_qty
attributes.description: The final order quantity approved by the buyer or auto-approved by the system after MOQ, order multiple, and buyer override adjustments. This is the quantity that will be transmitted to the supplier via EDI or purchase order.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Purchase Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: buyer_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a buyer has manually overridden the system-generated planned order quantity or parameters. True = buyer override applied; False = system-generated values accepted as-is. Supports audit trail for manual interventions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Buyer Override; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was first persisted in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the planned order value and unit cost are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: current_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU physically on hand at the supply node at the time the replenishment plan was generated. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS or SAP S/4HANA WM. Used as the starting inventory position for plan calculations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - On-Hand Inventory; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: A statistical measure of demand variability (coefficient of variation or standard deviation of demand) used by the planning engine to size safety stock. Higher values indicate more volatile demand and result in larger safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Variability Parameter

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: The target order fill rate percentage (Fill Rate) for this replenishment plan, representing the percentage of demand that should be fulfilled from available inventory. Used as a supply chain performance KPI (KPI) target for this SKU-node combination.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Fill Rate Target

attributes.name: forecasted_demand_qty
attributes.description: The total forecasted demand quantity for the SKU at the supply node over the plan horizon, as generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. The primary input to the planned order quantity calculation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Forecast; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected receipt at the supply node, as defined in the supplier contract or purchasing info record. Used to calculate reorder points and plan order release dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: min_order_value
attributes.description: The minimum monetary value of a purchase order required by the supplier, expressed in the operating currency. Replenishment plans that do not meet the minimum order value threshold are consolidated or flagged for buyer action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered from the supplier per purchase order line, as enforced by supplier contract terms. Replenishment plans with planned_order_qty below MOQ are rounded up or flagged for buyer review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record MOQ; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned order quantity meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) constraint. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold and requires buyer review or order consolidation before release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MOQ Validation; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of supply chain node receiving the replenishment. Values: store (retail store), dc (Distribution Center), mfc (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location). Drives replenishment logic and lead time parameters.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Node Classification

attributes.name: on_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU already on open purchase orders or in-transit to the supply node at the time of plan generation. Included in the net inventory position calculation to avoid over-ordering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Open Purchase Order Quantity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The unit increment in which the SKU must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Planned order quantities are rounded up to the nearest order multiple before purchase order generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; GS1 - Packaging Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: order_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the replenishment plan is scheduled to be released as a purchase order to the supplier. Calculated by subtracting lead time from the planned receipt date. Drives the purchasing execution calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Order Release Date; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why a buyer manually overrode the system-generated replenishment plan. Populated only when buyer_override_flag is True. Supports root cause analysis of planning accuracy and buyer behavior patterns.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Override Reason; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: plan_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment plan was generated by the planning engine (Blue Yonder or equivalent). Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for plan freshness assessment and demand signal alignment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Run Timestamp

attributes.name: plan_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the end of the demand forecast window. Together with plan_horizon_start_date, bounds the coverage period for this plan.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the beginning of the demand forecast window used to generate the planned order quantity.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the replenishment plan, generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning or SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used for cross-system traceability and supplier communication.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Order Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment plan within the planning and execution workflow. Drives automated ordering triggers and buyer review queues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|released|in_progress|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Status Lifecycle; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the origin and nature of the replenishment plan. Automated plans are system-generated by Blue Yonder; manual plans are buyer-created; override plans supersede automated recommendations; emergency plans address urgent stockout risk.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Type Classification; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: planned_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of units recommended by the planning engine to be ordered for this SKU at the specified supply node. Subject to MOQ and order multiple enforcement before release to purchasing.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planned Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Order

attributes.name: planned_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the planned replenishment order, calculated as planned_order_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Used for Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget management and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Open to Buy; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The expected date on which the replenishment order is planned to be received at the supply node, calculated as the order release date plus supplier lead time. Used for inventory projection and DC scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Receipt Date; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment plan was generated or adjusted to support a planned promotional event. True = promotion-driven uplift included in forecasted demand; False = baseline replenishment. Links to promotional demand lift in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Promotional Demand; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level (in units) at the supply node at which a replenishment order is triggered. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during supplier lead time. Core parameter for reorder-point-based replenishment policies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Reorder Point Calculation; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Parameters
